Vectors.

notes: *C班,每週二、三18:30~21:10(開學第二週開始上課)

description.zh: 為增進本校工程相關科系學生之基礎數學能力，本課程希望在18小時中，能使學生對基礎數學有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習微積分之數學基礎。課程內容包括：1. 數與式、2. 不等式、3. 直角坐標系、4. 直線、5. 圓錐曲線、6. 指數與對數、7. 三角函數、8. 向量。
description.en: With the purpose for improving the comprehension in fundamental mathematics for students who major in Engineering, and for building up solid background of Calculus for students' future training, it is planned to have this course. This 18 hours course aims at developing comprehension of basic mathematics、activating capabilities of Logic、strengthening the abilities of computing with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1. Numbers、Functions and Equations, 2. Inequalities, 3. Rectangular Coordinates, 4. Lines, 5. Quadratic Equations, 6. Exponents and Logarithms, 7. Trigonometric Functions , 8. Vectors.

notes: *D班,每週一、四18:30~21:10(開學第二週開始上課)

description.zh: 本課程主要在研討傳統的結構化語言的編譯技術。課程所所涵蓋的內容包括有： - 語句上的分析、語句分析器的製作 - 由上而下的組譯器製作 - 由下而上的組譯器製作 - 語意分析 - 機器碼之產生與暫存器之配置 - 資料流分析的理論與應用 - 程式碼最佳化處理。課程的實施，將以基本編譯技術為主，作深入的介紹。學習所得的觀念與技術，將利用一個實驗性語言編譯器的實作來貫穿。因此，程式規畫實作，將在這個課程中，佔有相當大的比重。
description.en: This course discusses issues in the compilation of conventional block-structured languages, as listed below. - lexical analysis, scanner generators; - top-down parsing, LL(1) parsers; - bottom-up parsing SLR, LALR, LR(1) parsers, parser generators; - semantic analysis; - code generation and register allocation, code generator generators; - dataflow analysis: theory and practice; - code optimization. There will be a significant programming component to the course

description.zh: 講授工程圖之基本原理及規則，並佐以必要之工程設計知識與AutoCAD繪圖技巧,培養學生具備熟練與有效率地將設計構想以工程圖方式正確表達的能力。
description.en: An introductory course providing the student with fundamental information, understanding and skills mainly in orthographic projection. Theories and principles of engineering drawing will be specifically introduced and concurrent with the practice of drafting for industrial design.

description.zh: 掌握形式從屬機能旨意，熟悉施作技術限制與創意可行性，學習從設計到實作的落實，透過各種機械設備操作、加工技術學習，實際接觸及操作真實材料，了解材料種類、性質、加工過程、組裝知識、技術與美學等，以呈現設計作品之原型與成品。
description.en: Based on “Form follows Function”, student will learn interacts and limitations among technology feasibility and creative application, in order to master sequential implementations form design ideas to real works. Students are required to operate various mechanical equipment and processing technologies, thus to realize the types and nature of the materials, processing procedure, as well as the assembly of knowledge, technologies and aesthetics to format intended design prototypes and establishments.

interdisciplinary: 木藝數位製造與管理微學程
notes: 家室組(木工廠)，請勿選錯組

description.zh: 應用設計手繪工具與技法於各種設計作品圖面呈現，培養學生對空間、形體、材質、介面、裝置、比例等簡潔繪畫技巧與圖示性設計圖表達能力。
description.en: Students will learn to sketch by hand in various tools and technologies on design drawings. The simple painting tips as, spatial perceptive, presentation of form and materials, interfaces media types and installations, and proportion as well as abilities of the infographic design presentation will be taught in this class.

description.zh: 讓學生習得3D 材質編修電腦軟體之技能，俾能將工業設計產品進行材質模擬與色彩計劃。
description.en: The study of materials edit computer software which could apply materials simulation and color plan on industrial design products.

description.zh: 本課程教授商品化實務概念並由學生實際操作，如何以一貫作業完成市場銷售商品。由消費者洞察開始，教導學生如何從消費者行為找到需求，進而思考產品設計動機。設計過程中涵蓋專利，製造與營運思維，最後以實際商品設計呈現。
description.en: The purpose of this course is study the concept of commercialization and how to sale the products to marketing through the consistent process.It’ll ask student to find the consumer's requirements from observation, then think and confirm the design purpose. The design process will include patent, manufacture, operating thinking, and commodity design.

interdisciplinary: 文化永續與社會創新-社會實踐微學程

description.zh: 本課程通過理論與實際案例介紹3D創作與空間設計軟體：3DS MAX的概念與應用範圍，接續將3D環境建構的方法導入實務案例練習操作，最後透過專題設定進行學生自己的內容創作。課程目的是訓練學生在運用3DS MAX軟體進行3D模型、角色造型、空間和相關物件的建構能力，並接續應用在空間展示的內容設計和表現。
description.en: This course content is about 3D creation and space design software through theoretical and practical cases: 3DS MAX - the concept and application scope, and then teacher introduces the methods of 3D environment construction into practical case practice operations, and finally creates students' own creation project. The purpose of the course is to train students to use the 3DS MAX software to construct 3D models, character modeling, space, and related objects, and use the result and performance to space display.

description.zh: 在不斷變化的設計領域，人工智慧 (AI) 正在改變設計師的工作方式。這種轉變不僅將人工智慧視為一種工具，而且將其視為協作夥伴，透過智慧和適應性重塑設計流程。隨著人工智慧在設計中的作用不斷擴大，一項關鍵技能出現了--提示工程 prompt engineering。課程中將介紹生成式AI的最新版本工具, ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion等工具進行 Prompt Engineering；並且學習如何用自己的資料訓練 ChatGPT。除此之外，更指導學生如何讓ChatGPT 成為自己的學習教練，在未來不斷變化的科技趨勢中不斷成長；並讓學生參與人工智慧倫理議題、版權和隱私的對話討論。學生將學習：1.使用當前最新版本的生成式AI工具與提示工程2.使用生成式AI 輔助設計流程3.使用生成式AI進行研究與資料分析4.使用OpenAI API Playground與建立簡單的應用程式5.使用生成式AI創作作品行銷影音與數位分身6.使用人工智慧的倫理議題、版權、隱私和未來影響
description.en: AI is redefining designer work in the evolving design field, emerging as both a tool and collaborator, enhancing design with its adaptability. The rise of AI in design highlights the importance of prompt engineering. This course explores cutting-edge generative AI tools for prompt engineering and training ChatGPT with personal data. It aims to teach students how to use ChatGPT as a learning coach, adapting to new tech trends. Additionally, it includes discussions on AI's ethical considerations, copyright, and privacy.Students will learn to use the latest generative AI tools and engage in prompt engineering to aid the design process, conduct research, and analyze data. They will utilize the OpenAI API Playground to build simple applications, create marketing content, digital avatars, and videos. Additionally, they will discuss ethical issues, copyright, privacy, and the future impact of artificial intelligence.

name.zh: 設計師的生成式AI提示工程

description.zh: 本課程為沿續統計學課程，探討論文寫作所需統計分析理論與方法。課程內容含: 一因子與二因子變異數分析、實驗設計、多元迴歸分析、因素分析、集群分析、區別分析與結構方程式等。 1. Introduction to SPSS 2. Analysis of Variance (ANOVA) 3. Experimental Design 4. Nonparametric Test 5. Multiple Regression 6. Factor Analysis 7. Cluster Analysis 8. Discriminant Analysis 9. Structural Equation Model (SEM)
description.en: This course focuses on application of statistical principles and methods. Course including ANOVA, Experimental Design, Nonparametric Test, Multiple Regression, Factor Analysis, Cluster Analysis, Discriminant Analysis and Structural Equation Model (SEM).

description.zh: 培養學生透過實證數據支持的方法來分析與解決設計問題。課程將以循證設計過程，包括如何收集、分析和應用研究數據以進行設計決策。學生將學習多種研究工具和方法及如何將這些方法應用於設計項目中。課程將通過講座、實務工作坊與研究調查使學生實際應用循證設計原則，並持續優化設計解決方案。課程學到的能力包括：1.循證設計的基本原則：理解循證設計的理論基礎和實踐應用，依據不同的設計主題應用適合的研究方法來輔助制定設計決策。2.研究方法和工具的運用：掌握使用各種研究工具和技術，包括質性和量化研究方法，以收集和分析數據。3.洞察設計優化方向：培養批判性思考能力，評估研究數據並能夠基於數據提出合理的設計解決方案。
description.en: This course trains students in analyzing and solving design issues using data-backed methods, focusing on the evidence-based design process. It covers data collection, analysis, and application in design decisions, introducing various research tools and techniques. The curriculum emphasizes practical application through lectures, workshops, and research projects, aiming at continuously improving design solutions. Key skills include understanding evidence-based design principles, mastering research methods and tools for data analysis, and developing critical thinking to optimize design direction based on research findings.

description.zh: 本課程教授商品化實務概念並由學生實際操作，如何以一貫作業完成市場銷售商品。由消費者洞察開始，教導學生如何從消費者行為找到需求，進而思考產品設計動機。設計過程中涵蓋專利，製造與營運思維，最後以實際商品設計呈現。
description.en: The purpose of this course is study the concept of commercialization and how to sale the products to marketing through the consistent process.It’ll ask student to find the consumer's requirements from observation, then think and confirm the design purpose. The design process will include patent, manufacture, operating thinking, and commodity design.

interdisciplinary: 文化永續與社會創新-社會實踐微學程

description.zh: 本課程通過理論介紹虛擬實境（Virtual Reality, VR）的概念與應用範圍，接續將3D環境建構的方法導入實踐操作，再透過專題設定進行內容創作，最終完成研究驗證的工作。課程目的是訓練學生在VR空間展示與設計研究端的流程，諸如3D環境設計、VR空間與內容建構、VR內容輸出與展示等能力。最終，學生可基於這些能力應用於各種虛擬空間的展示設計。
description.en: In this course, I will introduce the concept and scope of application of Virtual Reality (VR) via the theory, and then introduce the method of 3D environment construction into practical operation. Furthermore, this course will be showed how to creates content through a thematic setting, and finally completes the work of research and verification. The purpose of the course is to train students in the process of VR space display and design research, such as 3D environment design, VR space and content construction, VR content output, and display capabilities. Finally, students can apply these abilities to the display design of various virtual spaces.

name.zh: 虛擬空間展示與設計研究
name.en: Virtual Space Display and Design Research

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於研討生活環境設計之相關研究專題，以文獻研讀、論文研讀討論以及個案研究為重點，藉由密集討論、書面報告以及設計專題之之研究與實作，學生可以有效率地交換意見，獲得更深入而廣泛的體驗，並具備研究、分析、實作之能力。本所結合設計、藝術、人文、木工等各領域的學生，整合培育創新設計專業人才，因此，本課程之另一主要學習目標為建構一多元領域交互學習的環境，以專題導向式為學習模式，可分別組合具各種專長的研究生，協同完成生活環境設計專題的研究，或是透過生活環境設計個案研討、生活環境設計專題創作的方式進行。教學將以課堂講授、論文研討與發表以及專題實作為主，並以報告、分組討論與發表以及實作作品為評量方式。
description.en: The objective of this course is to discuss research topics related to living environment design, focusing on literature study, thesis study and discussion and case studies, through intensive discussion, written report and research and practice of design topics, students can exchange opinions efficiently, gain more in-depth and extensive experience, and have the ability to research, analyze and practice. Therefore, another major learning objective of this course is to construct a multi-field interactive learning environment, which can be combined with graduate students with various specialties to collaborate on research on living environment design topics, or through case studies on living environment design. Teaching will focus on classroom lectures, thesis discussions and presentations, and thematic facts, and will be evaluated by reports, group discussions and presentations, and practical works.

name.en: Special Topics on Living Environment Design

notes: 創新所和設計博合開, 配合USR計畫

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。工程最佳化方法導論、線性規劃法、非線性規劃法、多目標函數最佳化、近代數學規劃法介紹、精密機電元件與系統之最佳設計。
description.en: Engineering Optimization Concepts, Linear Programming Methods, Nonlinear Programming Methods, Multi-objective Optimization, Introduction to Modern Mathematical Programming Techniques, and Optimum Design of Precision Machine Components and Systems.

notes: 自動化所、鐵道、機電科博及外生班合開

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。 真空工程, 直流電源, 射頻電源, 微波, 熱燈絲等各種能量方式之CVD化學氣相沉積法, PVD物理氣相沉積法, 電鍍技術,以及膜的特性觀察與實驗，包括SEM，EDX，XRD與金相顯微觀察，附著力測試等。1.光電半導體V-I特性分析試驗 2.接面型光電元件C-V量測實驗 3.光導電及少數載體存活時間量測實驗 4.邁克蓀干涉儀實驗(3)5.雷射繞射實驗(3) 6.偏振實驗(3)7.分光儀實驗(3)
description.en: The practices in vacuum engineering, variety deposition methods such as CVD, PVD and electroplating, that include DC, RF, microwave hot filament etc are be performed. Tests of film properties and its characterizations such as SEM, EDX, XRD, and metallurgical microscope are also be examined.1.Experiment on V-I characteristics of photonic devices.2.C-V measurements of optoelectronic devices.3.Measurements of photoconductivity and minority-carrier lifetime of photonic materials.4.Lab on Michelson interferometer5.Lab Experiment on diffraction 6.Lab on polarization7.Lab on spectrometer

notes: 必選,大學時如已修過可申請改修其他專業選修抵學分

description.zh: 1. 機器學習簡介及基本概念2. 用於分類、迴歸和分群的機器學習演算法3. 機器學習模型訓練、評估與最佳化技術4. 機器學習在光電系統的應用
description.en: 1. Introduction and basic concepts of machine learning2. Machine learning algorithms for classification, regression and clustering3. Machine learning model training, evaluation, and optimization technology4. Application of machine learning in optoelectronic systems

description.zh: 超快雷射由於其脈衝寬度在皮秒(10-12)之下，它在軍事科技、工業應用、生醫檢測與學術研究所扮演的角色日益重要，本課程將介紹超短脈衝雷射的種類，尤其著重在光纖短脈衝雷產生的原理、脈衝壓縮的技術與超短脈衝寬度與相位量測的技術，此外也將介紹超快雷射的各種應用包括光譜量測、泵-探量測與非線性光學量測等技術。
description.en: Due to relative short pulse below one picosecond, ultrafast lasers have been widely used in various fields including military, industry, biomedical diagnosis and scientific research. In this course, it will introduce various kinds of the ultrafast lases, especially on the principle of mode-locked fiber generation, pulse compression technique and the method of the ultrashort pulsewidth measurement as well as phase retrieval. Various applications of ultrafast laser including fluorescence, pump-probe and nonlinear optical measurement have also been introduced in this course.

description.zh: 先修課程：電磁學、工程數學、近代物理。 由電磁學之理論推展光波之運行，並經由近代物理之量子論推導出之原子及分子能階與固態晶體之能帶理論，加以說明電磁波與物質間之作用。介紹共振腔、活化性介質及各種雷射之激發形式等雷射三個基本組成。並針對雷射光之種類、特性及其應用，加以說明。
description.en: Combining the propagation of optical wave been deduced from the electromagnetic theory and the quantum theory introduced by modern physics such as energy level of atom and molecular and the energy band of solid state, the interaction between electromagnetic wave and matter is introduced. The three fundamental components of laser: resonator, active medium, and pumping method are explained. Also the types, characteristics, and applications of various laser are introduced.

description.zh: 1. 人工智慧簡介及基本概念2. 各種人工智慧技術介紹3. 人工智慧工具和框架4. 人工智慧在光電領域的應用
description.en: 1. Introduction and basic concepts of artificial intelligence2. Introduction to various artificial intelligence technologies3. Artificial intelligence tools and frameworks4. Application of artificial intelligence in the field of optoelectronics

description.zh: 本課程主要是讓同學學習智慧顯示與感測相關的理論與瞭解相關產業動向，除了透過相關產業導師的教導與實地工廠的參訪，讓同學在最短的時間內對台灣智慧顯示與感測有初步的認識，此外，本課程也包含各種液晶元件的實作與其相關光電特性的量測與應用，讓同學能將理論與實務合而為一。
description.en: The main goal of this course is to teach students the theories and related industrial trends of intelligent displays and sensors. This will be achieved through lectures by industry experts and visits to factories, allowing students to gain a basic understanding of the relevant industries in Taiwan within a short period of time. The course will also include hands-on projects focusing on various LCD components and related optoelectronic properties measurement and application. By combining theory and practice, students can gain a comprehensive understanding of intelligent displays and sensors.

name.zh: 智慧顯示與感測含實習(I)
name.en: Intelligent display and sensing with internship (I)

interdisciplinary: 面板微學程

description.zh: 1.基本分析工具介紹(6) 2.基本光學系統--近軸光學(6) 3.光學系統元件介紹(6) 4.像差理論(6) 5.像質評估(6) 6.光學系統設計(6) 7.光學套裝軟體使用(6) 8.光電設計專題(9)
description.en: 1.The tools 2.The basic optical systems 3.Basic optical devices 4.Seidel aberrations 5.Image evaluation 6.The design of optical systems 7.The use of Zemax 8.Project on optical design

interdisciplinary: 太空科技微學程

description.zh: 1.光纖感測介紹，2.光纖感測元件，3.光纖感測系統，4.光纖感測多工技術，5.光纖雷射感測系統，6.長距離光纖感測系統，7.大範圍多點光纖感測系統，8.光纖感測網路。
description.en: 1. Introduction to fiber optic sensor, 2. Fiber sensor devices, 3. Fiber sensor systems, 4. Fiber sensor multiplexing techniques, 5. Fiber-laser-based sensor systems, 6. Long-distance fiber sensor systems, 7. Large-scale multipoint fiber sensor systems, 8. Fiber sensor networks.

interdisciplinary: 智慧感測科技微學程

description.zh: 本課程概念為數位化產品設計與開發介紹，為使學生明白數位化產品設計與開發在現代產業中的重要性，課程重點將介紹出版編輯觀念之基礎認識，讓學生增進對數位出版流程的理解，在設計過程中兼顧學理介紹與實務應用。另外探討數位劇本之優點、特性、設計步驟與要領、講述策略、核心技術、未來趨勢等。
description.en: The course is intended not only to familiarize students with the importance of digital products and development in the industry, but also to investigate the basic knowledge of editing and publishing. Students will have a combination of theoretical and practical training in this course.

notes: 互動二、外生三合開,限本系生35人

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於介紹行動裝置遊戲設計實務所需了解之專業知識與技術，並透過專題設計的操作使學生能具備行動裝置遊戲設計的實務能力。課程內容包含行動遊戲個案研究與市場分析、行動遊戲設計企劃、行動遊戲軟體設計應用、遊戲風格設計等。教學將以課堂講授、設計專案執行等方式進行，並以專題報告繳交以及專題設計作品發表為評量依據。
description.en: This course is focused on introducing the knowledge and techniques of mobile game design practice, accompanying with project design to allow students to be equipped with the capability of mobile game design practice. Course contents include mobile game case study and market analysis, mobile game design planning, software and game programming, game styling design. The course is preceded by means of lecturing and conducting design project. Students will be evaluated by project reports, design work and presentation.

name.zh: 行動裝置遊戲設計實務

interdisciplinary:
元宇宙微學程
產品創新開發與評估微學程
notes: 限本系及元宇宙微學程40人修

description.zh: 1.深度學習介紹，2.監督式學習，3.無監督式學習，4.物聯網，5.感知層，6.網路層，7.應用層，8. 深度學習與物聯網應用實例。
description.en: 1. Introduction to Deep Learning, 2. Supervised Learning, 3. Unsupervised Learning, 4. Internet of Things, 5. Perception Layer, 6. Network Layer, 7. Application Layer, 8. Deep Learning and Internet of Things

name.zh: 深度學習與物聯網應用
name.en: Deep Learning and Internet of Things

interdisciplinary:
半導體科技學程
智慧感測科技微學程

description.zh: 奈米科技在近年來有極快的進展，因此在本課程將介紹最新的奈米材料，包含有量子點、奈米碳材(富勒烯、奈米碳管、石墨烯)、二維奈米材料(二硫化鉬與金屬化)等，對於這些奈米材料的物理、化學與光電特性以及製程方法做進一步的介紹，以期許可以帶給同學當今最新的奈米化技術與科技知識。
description.en: Nanotechnology has a great progress in recent years. This class will introduce the latest information about nanomaterials and their applications. The nanomaterials include quantum dots, fullerene, carbon nanotube, graphene and molybdenum disulfide (MoS2). Their physical, chemical and optoelectronic properties will be comprehensively introduced. We expect to bring the knowledge of newest nanomaterials and technologies to students.

interdisciplinary:
能源材料微學程
先進材料化學微學程
半導體製程微學程
軟質材料與智慧紡織科技
notes: 先鋒教室;網路預選限25人(大學部);大四化工所合

description.zh: 讓學生學習文獻之蒐集方法與整理，以便瞭解學術論文製作方式，培養學生獨立自主探討一個理論或技術上的問題，並經由實驗設計及資料之判讀更深入專業領域。
description.en: A course allows students collect and oranize literature information and them design their own experiments. An independent research capability can be developed through out this learning process.

interdisciplinary: 智慧感測科技微學程
notes: 大四合開;選修專題須經指導教授同意

description.zh: 介紹多媒體各項基礎技術，包括文字、圖像、影像、動畫與音訊，以及各項技術的整合應用。
description.en: This course introduces the elements of multimedia design, including text, graphics, video, animation, and audio, as well as the applications of the integration of those elements.

notes: 本系生優先,限30人,新聘兼任教師

description.zh: 本課程概念為數位化產品設計與開發介紹，為使學生明白數位化產品設計與開發在現代產業中的重要性，課程重點將介紹出版編輯觀念之基礎認識，讓學生增進對數位出版流程的理解，在設計過程中兼顧學理介紹與實務應用。另外探討數位劇本之優點、特性、設計步驟與要領、講述策略、核心技術、未來趨勢等。
description.en: The course is intended not only to familiarize students with the importance of digital products and development in the industry, but also to investigate the basic knowledge of editing and publishing. Students will have a combination of theoretical and practical training in this course.

notes: 互動二與外生三合開，限25人,需自備筆電

description.zh: 如何藉由商務模型的分析，建置數位化協同產品設計與開發環境，並說明資料管理、構型管隨著網路時代的來臨，不但造成數位化協同產品設計與開發觀念的興起，也造成數位化協同平台技術逐漸成熟，並且將同步工程觀念的實現更往前邁進一大步。本課程是從數位化協同產品設計與開發概念之介紹開始，使學生明白數位化協同產品設計與開發在現代製造業中的重要性，接著介紹理與工作流程管理等相關實務應用觀念。
description.en: Information and network technologies have promoted the traditional concurrent engineering to the next generation. The collaborative e-design and e-development concept has been more popular in industries. This course is introduced from the concept of collaborative product design and development to help students understanding the importance of collaborative e-design and e-development in modern industries. Furthermore, the business model analysis method is provided to construct the collaborative environment of e-design and e-development. In addition, some real cases of data management, configuration management, and workflow management are mentioned.

name.zh: 數位化設計與開發特論
name.en: Special Topics on e-Design and e-Development

description.zh: 本課程主要介紹自動化光學精密檢測相關技術，內容包括如下：前言，精密量測概論，機器視覺原理，二維光學檢測技術及實習，三維光學檢測技術及實習，影像處理與人工智慧技術運用，智慧型量測系統及應用，系統整合之相關技術，產業相關技術應用，及結論。
description.en: This subject is arranged to introduce the principles and techniques required in Automatic Optical Inspection (AOI). The subject includes the following subtopics: introduction to precision metrology and machine vision, the measurement principles and methods used in the 2D AOI, the measurement principles and techniques used in the 3D AOI, image processing and artificial intelligence methods used in automatic inspection, intelligent measurement systems, AOI system integration and conclusion.

notes: 製科所必選課程之一/限21人

description.zh: 本課程適合修過工程數學及基礎熱流的大學生選修。使用Ansys 或其他商用軟體，來計算一維穩態，一維暫態，二維穩態，二維暫態，之熱傳導問題，邊界層之偶合性流場問題，燃燒場之數值計算，電子熱傳相關系統。
description.en: This course is suitable for the undergraduate students who have taken fundamental courses of engineering mathematics and thermofluid sciences. By using software of Ansys or other CFD packages to compute the one dimension steady, are dimension unsteady, two dimension steady, two dimension unsteady heat conduction problems, boundary layer compling flow's problems, combustion calculations, electronic heat transfer problems.

interdisciplinary: 綠能與節能微學程
notes: 機械三合開,限30人/綜科610,配合USR計畫

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹綠色科技及其在二十一世紀對人類生活的影響，內容包括現今幾個最重要的「潔能」與「節能」科技，以及一些「環保」相關科技。「潔能科技」包括風力能、太陽能、水力能、地球內部能源、生質能、路面能、聲音能、燃料電池、電動車等；「節能科技」包括節能住宅、變頻空調等；「環保科技」則包括碳回收主題。介紹內容包括各項技術原理介紹及其發展概況。
description.en: This course aims to introduce green technologies and their influences on human life in the 21st century. The contents consist of the most important topics about the clean energy and energy conservation technologies. The clean energy technology consists of wind energy, solar energy, hydraulic energy, earth interior energy, bioenergy, roadway energy, sound energy, fuel cell, electric vehicles, and so on. The energy conservation technology consists energy save buildings, variable frequency air-condition, etc.. The environmental protesting technology includes carbon recapture etc.. This course will talk the technical principles and their general developing situations.

interdisciplinary: 離岸風電跨域微學程

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。半導體材料、二極體、電晶體的原理、邏輯IC、記憶體IC。如物理沈積(PVD)、化學沈積(CVD)、高溫處理、微影、蝕刻及其相關設備介紹、廠物、維修、管理及工安等。IC封裝及測試。
description.en: Introduction to semiconductor material, diode, transistor, logic IC and memory IC, etc. description of the operation principles technology and related facilities about semiconductor fabrication processes, such as Physicalvapor deposition (PVD), chemical vapor deposition (CVD), doping , oxidation , heat process, lithography , and etching etc., discussion of utilities, maintenance, management and industrial safety in the factory. Discussion of IC packaging and testing.

interdisciplinary: 半導體設備微學程

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。變分微積分與最佳化之關係及其在工程最佳化上之應用、端點條件、不連續最佳化程序、無限制及有限制條件最佳化問題、直接法及實際最佳化設計應用等。
description.en: Introduction of Variational Calculus and its Application in the Engineering Optimal Design, Constrained/Unconstrained Optimal Design Problems, Discrete Optimal Control and Mathematical Programming, Practical Examples of Optimum Design.

interdisciplinary: 機電_第二專長【機械系_機械設計】

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。機構的類型合成與數目合成。創造性機構合成。運動、路徑和函數產生器之尺寸合成。最佳化設計。球面機構及空間機構之介紹。
description.en: Type Synthesis and Number Synthesis of Mechanisms. Creative Mechanism Synthesis.Dimensional Synthesis of Motion, Path, and Function Generators. Optimal Design. Introduction of Spherical Mechanisms and Spatial Mechanisms.

interdisciplinary: 半導體設備微學程
notes: 機電所.製科所.半導體.機械自動化.機電博及外生班合開

description.zh: 本課程將以問題導向學習的模式，學習設計思考的五個核心步驟：同理心分析、問題定義、創意發想、雛型發展、驗證評估。並透過實際案例的分析與操作，學習互動設計跨領域創新的方法。本課程的主要目標在於提供學生：1.了解互動設計的方法與步驟；2.探討互動設計跨領域創新的方法與操作模式；3.透過實務案例的操作累積互動設計的執行經驗。
description.en: This course will use Problem-based Learning method to teach the five kernel steps of design thinking including the following: Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, and Test. It will also help students in knowing the interdisciplinary innovation methods of interaction design by case studies and real case operation. The main course goals include the following: gain an understanding of the methods and steps of interaction design; explore the methods and operation models for the interdisciplinary innovation of interaction design; and gain the experiences of interaction design by real cases analysis and operation.

notes: PBL教室授課,互動三與外生三合開

description.zh: 服務設計的方法乃是透過相關資源做適當的規劃與組織，已提昇使用者與服務提供者間之服務及互動的品質。其主要的架構與方法乃在於了解使用者的行為、需求及動機後，創造具友善性、競爭性、及相關性的使用者經驗。本課程將以服務設計的概念與方法為核心，以使用者需求及經驗的創造為基礎，探討並分析不同的互動技術的適用情境及其發展與應用領域。
description.en: Service design is the activity of planning and organizing related resources of service in order to improve its quality and the interaction between service provider and users. The backbone of service design methodologies is to understand the behavior of the users, their needs and motivations, so that to create user-friendly, competitive and relevant service to the users. The service design concepts and methodologies and user experience analysis are used in this course for discussing the developments and applications of interactive technologies in the aspects of various scenarios and application fields.

notes: 日碩,外碩,設計博所合開,排PBL教室,限30人修

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。介紹精密機電系統之基本架構包括機械系統(如機架、基礎、導程與軸承、動力傳遞系統等)及控制系統(如製程控制、數值控制、幾何資料處理、進給驅動器、位置量測系統、機器監視與診斷等)，探討先進精密機電系統(如工具機、機器人、FMS、CIM、微機電系統等)。
description.en: This course will give an introduction to basic components of the precision mechatronic system including mechanical systems (e.g. machine frame, machine foundation, bearings and guides, power transmission etc.) and control systems (e.g. process control, numerical control, geometric data processing, driving systems, position measurement system, automatic manufacturing monitoring and diagnostics, etc. ). Studies of advanced precision mechatronic systems including machine tools, robotics, FMS, CIM , micro- electro- mechanical systems (MEMS) and so on.

interdisciplinary:
機電_第二專長【機械系_精密製造】
半導體設備微學程

description.zh: 本課程涵蓋半導體產業趨勢發展、超大型(Giga)半導體工廠廠務系統與先進自動化工廠運作、以及先進半導體製程技術和設備等三大部分。
description.en: This course mainly consists of development trend, Giga FAB, FAB automation, and processing technology and equipment for advanced semiconductor manufacturing.

name.zh: 積體電路製程先進技術與設備
name.en: Processing technology and equipment for advanced semiconductor manufacturing

interdisciplinary:
半導體科技學程
半導體設備微學程
半導體製程微學程
notes: 限40人/上課教室由教務處安排

description.zh: 現代控制理論簡介、線性空間分析、狀態方程式及響應、可控制性及可觀測性、穩定性分析、狀態回授及估測、控制器設計及應用、觀測。
description.en: Introduction of Modern Control Theory﹒Linear space Analysis, State equation and Response, Controllability and Observability, Stability Analysis, State Feedback and Estimation, Controller Design and Applications, Observer Design and Applications, Nonlinear systems, Time varying Systems, Applications of Modern Control theory.

description.zh: 於2009年，ASTM定義了積層製造，並將此積層製造分成七大類型，本課程將對它進行光機電原理說明，並以積層製造系統的應用及系統的研發為主要授課方向。
description.en: ASTM Committee F42 on Additive Manufacturing Technologies was formed in 2009. The myriad process names into seven standardized terms. In this course, the principle of the additive manufacturing technology in terms of its opto-electro-mechanical-system will be discussed. The application and the system development of additive manufacturing are the major topics of this course.

notes: 機電所.製科所.機械自動化外生班合開,全英,

description.zh: 原子結構、排列與運動、材料之顯微結構與相結構、材料之機械性質-疲勞、破裂、潛變、材料之電性-電傳導性與半導體性、材料之光性與介電性、材料之磁性、材料之熱學性質、材料在微電元件之應用、複合材料。9.複合材料。
description.en: Contents:1.Fundamentals: Atomic scale structure, Crystal structure. 2.Microstructural development: Phase equilibriums and phase diagram. 3.Properties: Mechanical properties, Electrical properties, Dielectric properties, Magnetic properties, Thermal properties. 4.Composite materials.5.Applications on the Electrical-mechanical devices. Objectives: To improve the related knowledge of materials on the electrical-mechanical devices.

notes: 限50人,機電所和鐵道合開

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。1.超音波技術簡介2.基礎彈性力學3.彈性動力學4.平面波5.平面波的反射6.平面波的折射7.表面波8.藍姆波(平板波)9.超音波於非破壞檢測之應用10.超音波於材料性質量測之應用11.超音波於醫學診斷與治療之應用12.超音波於感測器及通訊應用之應用13.超音波於加工應用之應用
description.en: 1.Introduction to ultrasonics 2.Basic elasticity for ultrasonics 3.Elastodynamics 4.Plane waves 5.Reflection of plane waves 6.Refraction of plane waves 7.Surface waves 8.Lamb waves 9.Ultrasonics in nondestructive testing 10.Application of ultrasonics to material characterizations 11.Application of ultrasonics in medical diagnostics and treatments 12.Application of ultrasonics to sensors and telecommunications 13.Application of ultrasonics to machining

notes: 製科所必選課程之一/限25人

description.zh: 本課程介紹電子顯微鏡之結構，成像及繞射原理，以及在材料科學方面之應用，課程內容包括穿透式電子顯微鏡之構造，電磁透鏡與成像原理，電子繞射原理，繞射圖型分析，試片之製作方法。掃描式電子顯微鏡之構造及成像原理。EDS及WDS之X光光譜測量。
description.en: The course introduces the structure of a electron microscope, the theories of image forming and diffraction, the applications of materials science. The course contents include structure of the transmission electron microscope, the electromagnetic lens and theory of image formation, theory of electronic diffraction, analysis of diffraction pattern, and the preparation of test sample. The structure and principle of forming image for a scanning electron microscope, the X-ray spectrography of EDS and WDS are also included in this course.

interdisciplinary:
半導體科技學程
半導體設備微學程
notes: 製科所必選課程之一/限30人

description.zh: 先修課程：指導教授同意科技研發專案管理之個案研究. 有關科技開發案之技術開發管理, 人力責任管理及時間任務管理等PDCA (Plan, Do, Check, Action)之實務探討
description.en: The cases study of the management of R/D projects. The method of PDCA (Plan, Do, Check, Action) cycling will be studied and discussed in each case.

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。精密機械之機械控制、電氣控制、數值控制、幾何數據處理、驅動系統、適應控制系統、監視系統與診斷系統、機器人控制、電腦整合精密機械系統。
description.en: Mechanical control, electrical control, numerical control, geometric data processing, drive systems, adaptive control systems, monitoring and diagnostic systems, and Computer Integrated precision Machinery Systems.

description.zh: 本課程將以做中學的概念，也就是技術實作+AI輔助教學的方式進行，內容主要是介紹光學成像技術與應用，特別是針對航太領域使用的光學技術，當然也適用於一般民生工業用途。例如：衛星遙測、流體顯像、太空測距等，以實際應用需求導入相關原理與技術介紹，搭配電腦軟體輔助學習，內容包括：光束成像、光波成像、光學成像元件精密加工、光學成像實務應用技術等項目，將安排專業教授及業師搭配授課，授課分成兩學期實施，上學期講授光束成像，下學期講授光波成像。
description.en: This course will be conducted using the concept of learning by doing, which is a combination of technical practice and AI-assisted teaching. The content mainly introduces optical imaging technology and its applications, especially optical technology used in the aerospace field, such as satellite remote sensing, flow visualization, space ranging, etc. Of course, it is also suitable for general industrial applications. The course will introduce relevant principles and technical introductions according to practical application needs, and computer software will be used for learning. The content includes beam imaging, wave imaging, precision processing of optical imaging components, practical application technology of optical imaging, and other topics. Professional professors and industry experts will be arranged to teach the course, which will be divided into two semesters. The first semester will cover beam imaging, and the second semester will cover wave imaging.

description.zh: 本課程以落地產業應用技術爲主題，導入德國工業大學任務導向學習模式，課程教導學生從建置雲端資料庫伺服器到撰寫三機一體網頁控制程 式進行工廠 CPS 產銷戰情資訊管理系統，串聯工廠人機物料及生產線與 品管，並實務教導開發 AI 瑕疵檢測模型，再利用人機操控 PLC 達到機聯網，進行工廠整廠資訊連線。
description.en: The theme of this course is industrial application technology, and it introduces the task-oriented learning model of the German University of Technology. The course teaches students from building a cloud database server to writing a three-in-one web control program for factory CPS production and sales information management system, connecting factories Human-machine material, production line and quality control, and practical teaching and development of AI defect detection model, and then use human-machine control PLC to achieve machine networking, and conduct factory-wide information connection.

name.zh: 數位製造結合 AI 科技應用(一)
name.en: Digital manufacturing integrated with AI technology application I

description.zh: 先修課程：3002014或負責教授同意。一維及多維穩定態熱傳導及非穩定態熱傳導、對流原理、強迫對流及自然對流經驗和實驗關係式、輻射熱傳遞、凝結與沸騰、熱交換器、熱傳遞中的特殊論題。
description.en: Steady-State Conduction-One Dimension, Steady-State Conduction-Multiple Dimensions, Unsteady-State Conduction, Principles of Convection, Empirical and Practical Relations for Forced-Convection Heat Transfer, Natural- Convection Systems, Radiation Heat Transfer, Condensation and Boiling Heat Transfer, Heat Exchangers, Special Topics in Heat Transfer.

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意（1） 瞬時平面運動學：Hartman構圖法,反曲點元，切線圓，Euer- Savary方程式，Bobillier構圖法，四連桿組耦桿之直線包絡線方程式，Higher Curvature（2） 平面連桿機構分析：Freudenstein方程式，速度及加速度，傳遞角與機械利益，多迴路連桿組分析（3） 其它機構分析：凸輪，齒輪組，非圓形齒輪
description.en: （1） Instantaneous Plane Kinematics:Hartman's construction, Inflection circle ,Tangential circle ,Euler -Savary Equation ,Bobillier's construction, Higher curvature（2） Analysis of plane Linkage:Freudenstein Equation, Velocity and Acceleration, Transmission Angle and Mechanical Advantage, Multiple-Loop linkage（3） Analysis of Cams, Gear Trains, Non-Circular Gears.

notes: 機電所.製科所.鐵道.機械自動化.機電博及外生班合開

description.zh: 使學員瞭解Python程式語言於機器學習應用，以及機器學習的理論背景、評估如何使用適當的演算法於實際例子、內容包括回歸分析於資料預測、資料維度減少方法於資料特徵提取、資料分類方法包括支援向量機與類神經網路方法。課程主要配合Python例子增進學員了解機器學習的相關知識與提升在資訊處理時代之競爭力。
description.en: Students should be familiar with the basic concepts of machine learning (ML), probability theory, probability distribution, ML algorithms for classification, regression, and clustering taught in this class.

interdisciplinary:
半導體科技學程
生醫輔助科技跨域微學程
半導體設備微學程
notes: 機電所、機電博及外生班合開,限26人

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。機器人簡介、齊次轉換矩陣、運動方程式及反運動方程式、軌跡規劃、機器人動力學、機器人控制系統、機器人程式語言、機器人於工業界之應用技術。
description.en: Introduction to Robotic Manipulators, Homogeneous Transformations, Kinematic Equations and Solutions, Trajectory Planning, Dynamics and Control of Robots, Programming and Applications.

interdisciplinary: 自動化科技學程

description.zh: 本課程以機械製造結合工業4.0技術為主，包括近代製造技術概論、E化製造、物聯網基本介紹、巨量資料於製程優化的應用、智慧型演算之原理與應用、機器視覺檢測應用、彈性製造系統、網宇實體系統、智能化工廠應用實例、應用APP撰寫等，增進學生對現代製造技術內容之理解、內化、與判斷應用能力，並加強工業4.0相關最新科技之介紹與應用，以期培養對應用聯網技術、大數據、雲端運算、及人工智慧於製造相關課題有技術與能力之工程師。
description.en: This course is based on integration of mechanical manufacturing and industry 4.0, which is made of the modern manufacturing, the computational manufacturing,the internet of things, the optimization of manufacturing using big data, the intelligent calculation, machine vision measurement, flexible manufacturing, CPS system, smart factory, APP, etc.. This course can improve student’s knowledge of modern manufacturing, judgment, and industry 4.0, which will further create engineers with networking technology, big data, cloud calculation, and artificial intelligence in manufacturing.

interdisciplinary:
智慧感測科技微學程
軟質材料與智慧紡織科技

description.zh: 偏微分方程式、變分法、張量分析、工程統計及積分方程式等工程分析用工具知識。
description.en: Partial Differential equation, Variation Principle, Tensor Analysis, Engineering Statistics and Integral equation.

notes: 機電.製科.機械自動化外生班.機電博及外生班合開,限25

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。本課程主要介紹幾何光學與Coherent光學兩部份之基本概念與應用﹐提供機械領域的學生有關光的知識﹐讓機械領域的學生有能力加入機光電技術整合。本課程首先介紹幾何光學﹐幾何光學雖然簡單﹐卻是光學應用最普遍的知識﹐接著進入Coherent光學原理與應用介紹﹐Coherent光學在光量測技術部份佔了非常重要的地位﹐透過本課程的訓練﹐學生將可更順利的進入光學實驗室工作﹐當然﹐本課程也適合其他對光學有興趣的學生來修習。
description.en: The lectures in this course include two main parts, the geometrical and the coherent optics. Due to the future high technology, the optomechatronics, needs the cooperation of knowledge among the optics, the electrics, and the mechanics. This course gives the students of mechanical engineering the chance to participate in this work group. The lecture will first show the students the geometrical optics which is simple but important in the field of optical application. The coherent optics is the main part in this course which occupies the most optical technique of measurement. After the course the students should have the enough knowledge to work in the optical laboratory. Certainly, this course is also useful for all students who are interest in the area of the optics.

description.zh: 先修課程：3001053或負責教授同意。Z-轉換、取樣資料系統、等效於連續函數的數位濾波器設計、使用轉換技術設計數位控制系統、使用狀態空間設計數位控制系統、電腦控制。
description.en: Z-Transform, Sampled-Data Systems, Discrete Equivalents to Continuous Transfer Functions: The Digital Filter, Design of Digital Control Systems Using Transform Techniques, Design of Digital Control Systems Using State-Space Methods, Application and Practice of Digital Control, Case Study.

interdisciplinary: 自動化科技學程

description.zh: 奈微米工程於生物醫學之應用日趨重要，量測與操作工具的開發與實際的生醫應用對象的大小尺寸具有密切的相關性，對於生物系統的充份瞭解是工程表現的重要過程之一。在此課程中將配合本校實驗室目前之相關研究設備進行原理講解與應用討論，包括之項目將由分子、細胞到組織之感測、分析與操縱。選修學生須依下列重點：奈微米生醫感測系統、奈米生醫材料、奈米生醫光電以及實驗室晶片等領域選擇期中期末報告之題目與計畫內容，主要要求在尋求創新思考方向，以求在原理或應用上的突破，積極推動跨領域與技術先進之整合性研究。
description.en: Nano/micro engineering in bio-medicine applications has become increasingly important. The development and operation of measurement tool for biomedical applications has a close correlation to the actual size of the object. In this course we will explain the principles of devices and discuss the applications based on the school's research laboratories, including sensing, analysis and manipulation of molecules, cells, and tissues. Students will be required to do a project about Nano-micron biomedical sensor systems, nano-biomaterials and nano-biomedical areas such as optical and lab-chip. The interim and final report should devote to the topic and plans in the search for the direction of Creative Thinking with a view to the breakthrough of theory or application, and actively promote the integration of advanced interdisciplinary research and technology.

interdisciplinary: 生醫材料學程

description.zh: 先修課程：數位電路與微處理器工業自動化基本控制元件的設計觀念、使用方法與應用規劃；內容包含人機介面裝置(Human Machine Interface, HMI)、可程式邏輯控制器(Programmable Logic Controller, PLC)、交流伺服馬達(AC Servo Motor)的原理解說與應用設計實作課程。
description.en: Pre-requisites：Digital Circuit, MicroprocessorThe fundamental design concepts、operations and application development of industrial automation controllers are focused. Architectures and applications design of Human Machine Interface(HMI), Programmable Logic Controller(PLC) and AC Servo Motor are introduced. Hands-on work and exercises are included.

interdisciplinary:
光電智慧製造學程
半導體設備微學程

description.zh: 控制理論及應用簡介、線性空間及線性運算子、線性動態方程式及反應、可控制性可觀測性及穩定性、狀態回授及狀態預估、多變數I/O控制器設計及應用。
description.en: Introduction, Linear spaces and linear operators, linear dynamic equations, controllability, observability, stability analysis, state feedback and state prediction, multi-input multi-output systems, controller design and application.

interdisciplinary: 半導體設備微學程
notes: 限25人/須具備MATLAB基礎並自備筆電

description.zh: 本課程由機械工程的角度出發，結合基礎電化學原理，介紹燃料電池的基本原理及種類，由最新市場發展現況導入，介紹燃料電池的發展歷史及最新現況，同時說明提升燃料電池效率及壽命的關鍵影響因素，結合實作方式深入了解燃料電池特性。
description.en: This course is based on the principle of mechanical engineering and electrochemical theory to introduce the basic principles and types of fuel cells. From the latest development in the global market, the course will introduce the fuel cell history and the latest products of fuel cells. The improvement of fuel cell efficiency and lifetime will be explained through fundamental theory and experiments.

name.en: Principle and application of fuel cell

description.zh: 本課程以“智能工業生產教學工廠”為學習場域，整間工廠完全由北科大跨系所老師帶領學生自行建置，產線包括加工區、精密量測區、線上品管區、組裝區、自動倉儲，從接受訂單到智能化排單、加工、量測、品管、組裝、倉儲，所有雲端伺服器與程式軟體完全由學生自行架設與撰寫，是一條完全無人化的關燈展示生產與教學工廠。上課方式是廠商針對智能工廠各個工作細節具體提出實務需求，再由上課老師帶學生助教以此些問題作為上課基礎，教導學生共同解決，學生以班級為單位進入工廠實作學習，課程由負責建置“智能工業生產教學工廠”的老師依其專長領域分工合作開課，依據老師負責建置的部分及其專長進行分工教學，學生分組由個別老師帶領指導，學生將可依序學到完整工廠技術，學期結束再由各專長老師依照學生分組指導學生進行專題報告，學生的專題報告將以個別老師專長協助解決的問題撰寫報告，這樣的設計可以讓學生深入了解與探討如何解決問題。
description.en: This course is based on the intelligent manufacturing system education factory. The intelligent factory is completely built by ourselves and is the only one self-built factory in Taiwanese universities. The intelligent manufacturing system has seven areas, central server, reception, automatic warehouse, manufacturing, measuring, on-line quality control, and assembly. In process, we receive the raw materials and scanned by QR code scanner. After scanned, the raw materials are transported to the warehouse and wait for producing order. If the producing order received, the raw materials will be sent through all seven machines, where a finished component will be manufactured. One component from that batch will be sent to the measuring area for complete quality control, and the remaining compone.

interdisciplinary: 智慧創新網宇實體系統設計與開發微學程

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。量測原理及訊號處理的一般方法（含放大電路、動態響應及頻譜分析），說明各種感測器之原理、規格、結構圖、應用的場合及其訊號處理（含速度、位移、加速度、力量、扭矩、功率、壓力、流量、溫度、化學組成、濕度、濃度、照度、電流、電壓、磁通量、磁場強度、各型感測開關等），感測器與電腦之連線。
description.en: Measurement Principles, General Methods for Signal Processing (Amplified Circuits, Dynamic Response, and Frequency spectrum Analysis), Discussion of Principle, Specification, Structure, Occasion and Location of Application of a Variety of Sensors for Measuring Physical Quantities,such as Displacement, Velocity, Acceleration, Force, Torque, Power,Pressure, Flow Rate, Temperature, Chemical Composition, Humidity,Density, Luminosity, Current, Voltage, Magnetic Flux, Magnetic Intensity , a Variety of Sensing Switch, etc.

interdisciplinary:
自動化科技學程
機電_第二專長【機械系_精密製造】
半導體設備微學程

description.zh: 炸藥與爆破工程應用於岩石爆破，為採礦及大地工程的基本作業。本課程之目的在介紹炸藥性質、炸藥反應原理、爆材特性及應用、爆破設計及施工並兼及爆破作業之環境控制。
description.en: The blasting engineering course focuses on the introduction of explosives and their properties and characteristics,explosives and blasting theories, drilling and blastingdesign and operations, and environemtnal control ofblasting.

description.zh: 本課程以講授廢棄物之中間處理與最終處置之方法與技術為主,使學生瞭解廢棄物妥善清除處理之原理,此包括: 1.廢棄物種類與含義2.廢棄物分類收集與清運3.焚化處理4.固化處理 5.掩埋處置6.特殊處理方法7.廢棄物處理廠之規劃.
description.en: To promote the knowledge of principle for students,the course ,Waste Treatment andDisposal,focuses on middle treatment and final disposal of waste. Contents of thecourse include:Definition and classification of waste.Storage andtransportation,Incineration,Fixation,Landfill and Overall planning of treatmrnt plant.

interdisciplinary: 循環經濟與淨零永續微學程

description.zh: 本課程將討論材料凝固熱力學、材料凝固動力學、平衡及非平衡狀態下材料的凝固現象與凝固界面之溶質濃度分佈情形。課程最後會介紹凝固學在工業界的應用實例：單晶成長與鑄造工程。
description.en: This lecture will first discuss the Thermodynamics and Dynamics for Solidification in Materials under equilibrium and non-equilibrium states. Second, we will discuss the Solidification behavior and solutes distribution at the interface between solid and liquid. Finally, we will briefly introduce the applications of Solidification in industry cases: Single Crystal Growth and Casting engineering.

description.zh: 訓練學生獨立思考，培養學生對礦物資源之認識及應用能力，專題內容包括資源開發及地質工程、資源應用及材料合成、以及資源處理及材料製程等三大專長領域。學生必須研讀相關文獻後再研討專題實驗內容，並對實驗及結果加以詳述，而完成學士論文報告。
description.en: This course is trying to train independent thinking, to cultivate understanding and apply ability of mineral resources, the content of this subject includes the mining and geology engineering, the use of resources and materials synthesis, the resources and materials handling process, etc.. All the students must study related documents before they research the subject-matter content, they have to make a detailed report to the experiment and result at the final report.

name.en: Special Topics on Mineral Resources Engineering (II)

interdisciplinary: 智慧感測科技微學程

description.zh: 本課程將介紹電腦輔助工程計算的工具與案例，引導學生使用電腦輔助工程軟體進行資源工程領域的研發設計與計算，課程以COMSOL MULTIPHYSICS為主要操作環境，另並用如EXCEL / VBA、MATLAB或SOLIDWORKS等軟體進行分析、導入或導出，探討案例包括流體力學、熱傳、質傳、電鍍、腐蝕、電池等，學生將能了解數學模擬的觀念、基礎建模的邏輯以及電腦輔助工程計算的研發模式。
description.en: This course will introduce the tools and cases of computer-aided computation and guide students in using software to solve engineering problems. The course takes COMSOL MULTIPHYSICS as the main operating environment and might use software such as EXCEL/VBA, MATLAB or SOLIDWORKS etc. by importing or exporting various model formats. Topics include fluid mechanics, heat transfer, mass transfer, electroplating, corrosion, batteries, etc. Students will be able to understand the concept of mathematical simulation, the basic logic of modeling, and the R&D process of computer-aided engineering.

description.zh: 寶石業為台灣新興的工業之一，集地質學、礦物學、結晶學、切割技術、商業行為及藝術美感於此門學問，寶石礦物的物理及化學性質和鑑定，寶石礦物的生成和產狀及其地理公布，如何加工，銷售行為如何進行，珠寶的設計方式及製造。寶石礦物之顏色分類，內含物之特色，光學現象之表現。人造寶石之製造與辨認，均讓學習者有能力鑑定其真偽，價值與市場行為。
description.en: Introduction the physics and chemistry properties of gemstones.

description.zh: 嵌入式系統目前愈來愈普遍。它將會大大地影響我們的生活方式。可攜式裝置如智慧型手機、掌上型電腦、以及所謂的IA裝置如家用網路閘道器、數位視訊錄影機、和常見的遊戲機都是屬於嵌入式系統的範疇。在本課程中,我們將會討論何謂嵌入式系統、嵌入式系統的形式、以及如何建構一個嵌入式系統。由於嵌入式系統包含硬體及軟體的議題，我們也會探討相關的主題。 本課程的先修課程包含計算機組織與結構、C程式語言、資料結構、系統程式、以及作業系統。課程主要內容如下：嵌入式系統簡介與概論、嵌入式精簡指令集結構、ARM指令集、嵌入式計算平台、嵌入式程式設計與分析、嵌入式作業系統、系統設計技術、裝置操作、網路。本課程亦包含實習與學期專題作業。
description.en: Embedded systems are more and more popular today. It will affect the human life greatly. Portable devices like smart phone, PDA, and MP3 player, and so-called IA devices such as home gateway, DVR, and game machine are all categorized as embedded systems. In this course, we will discuss what an embedded system is, what it looks like, and how to build an embedded device. Since an embedded system involves hardware and software issues, we will discuss the related subjects. The prerequisite courses for this class include computer organization and architecture, the C programming language, data structure, system programming, and operating system. The major topics of this course are listed as follows: Introduction and Basic Concepts, The RISC Embedded Architectures, The ARM instruction Set, The Embedded Computing Platforms, Program Design and Analysis, The Embedded Operating Systems, System Design Techniques, Device Manipulation, Networks.

notes: 資工四、資工所和電資國際班合開

description.zh: 本課程介紹以ARM CPU為核心之嵌入式系統。內容包含：ARM CPU介紹，ARM CPU指令集，ARM 之C 語言工具，ARM 發展環境，Evaluation board 之介紹，Emulator之介紹，ARM 之C 語言程式撰寫及偵錯，Linux核心之介紹，應用Linux為核心之作業系統於ARM之Evaluation board，Linux驅動程式之撰寫及安裝，應用實例之介紹，及期末專題。
description.en: This course covers the following topics: introduction to ARM CPU, instruction set of ARM CPU, C complier of ARM CPU, debugging tools for ARM CPU, functions of the evaluation board, usage of emulator, writing and running C language in the evaluation board, introduction to Linux kernel, porting Linux kernel to the evaluation board, writing and installing the Linux device drivers, examples of applications, and term project.

interdisciplinary: 無人機微學程
notes: 資工四、資工所和電資國際班合開

description.zh: 本課程將深入的討論材料之光電及表面性質，並經由實習實驗量測各種相關特性。尤其是在材料電子理論的應用方面。所涵蓋的主題包括有：電子理論、光學特性、繞射理論、表面科學、以及材料之磁性與熱力學性質。
description.en: After successfully completing this subject a student should be able to: (i) explain the fundamental aspects of electrical properties of materials, (ii) describe and understand energy method, (iii) describe and discuss nanoscale properties of materials, (iv) apply advanced properties of materials to engineering design problems, and (v) execute related measurements.

name.zh: 高等材料性質學與實習
name.en: Advanced Properties of Materials and Related Practice

notes: 製科所、機電博班及外生班合開,限20人

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意材料機械性質是強調材料巨觀性質與材料微觀結構, 鍵結及晶體結構之間的關係, 是一門實務性,基本且重要的課程。它包括彈性, 塑性行為, 差排理論, 單晶與聚晶材料之塑性變形, 複合材料, 高溫聚晶材料之變形, 非晶質材料之永久變形, 材料強化機構, 材料破壞, 潛變與氫脆性等問題之討論。
description.en: This course deals with the mechanical behavior of materials. It emphasizes the relationship among macroscopic properties, material microstructure, and fundamental concepts of bonding and crystal structure. Contents of this course include the elastic and elastic behavior , dislocation , plastic deformation in single and polycrystalline materials ,strengthening mechanism of crystalline materials, composite materials, high temperature of crystalline materials ,fracture , fatigue and embrittlement.

interdisciplinary: 軟質材料與智慧紡織科技
notes: 製科所、機電博班及外生班合開,限20人

description.en: 1.Linear Elasticity 2.Variational Method 3.Variational Principles of Elasticity 4. Structural Mechanics 5.Torsion 6.Energy Method 7.Elastic Stability 8.Materials Selection

description.zh: 此課程旨在以使用者為中心的觀點，說明產品與服務之開發與設計相關概念，並以實作方式應用使用者研究的方法，收集、分析與呈現研究資料與成果，使學生具備使用者研究的執行與發表能力。
description.en: From the human-centered perspective, this course explains concepts about the development and design of products and services. By practicing user research methods, students will learn how to collect and analyze the data, and present the findings of user research.

interdisciplinary: 產品創新開發與評估微學程
notes: 工管二甲乙丙合開, 配合USR計畫

description.zh: 本課程的主要目的在學習物流管理的基本觀念與應用。課程內容包括：(1) 物流管理基本概念、(2)物流系統設計、(3)物流資訊科技、(4)物流運輸作業、(5)存貨管理、(6) 倉儲作業、(7)配送作業、(8)物流委外管理、(9)全球物流管理、(10)永續物流管理。
description.en: This course will introduce basic concept and application of logistics management. The topics addressed in this course include: (1) Basic concept and application of logistics management, (2) Logistics system and network design, (3) Logistics information technology, (4) Transportation management, (5) Inventory management, (6) Warehouse management, (7) Distribution management, (8) Logistics outsourcing management, (9) Global logistics management, (10) Sustainable logistics management.

description.zh: 本課程預計搭配中國工業工程學會的「永續工程師」證照檢定考試做授課，由工程面與管理面探討淨零排放趨勢下，企業永續下工業工程所需具備的能力與知識。其中管理篇包括：企業永續發展、永續發展與氣候變遷風險管理、碳中和浪潮與因應之道、綠色供應鏈管理、永續金融、氣候相關財務揭露建議、資源永續與產業共生、與永續經濟決策分析。工程篇則包括：永續供應鏈設計、永續與能源政策、排放權交易與碳定價、綠色產品設計與評估、綠色物流與綠色冷鏈、產品服務系統、綠色聰明生產與循環經濟、清潔生產等理論與案例實務。
description.en: This course is designed to cover the knowledge and skills required for sustainable industrial in the context of net-zero emissions. It will be taught in conjunction with the "Sustainable Engineer" certification exam of the Chinese Institute of Industrial Engineers. The course will explore the topics from both engineering and management perspectives, focusing on sustainable enterprise development. The management chapters will cover a range of areas such as climate change, sustainable finance, green supply chain, carbon-neutral strategies, climate-related financial disclosure, resource sustainability, and industrial symbiosis, as well as sustainable economic decision analysis. Meanwhile, the engineering chapters will delve into topics such as sustainable supply chain design, energy policies, carbon pricing, green product design and evaluation, green logistics, product-service systems, green smart production, circular economy, and clean production theories and case studies.

interdisciplinary: 低碳與永續管理微學程

description.zh: 機械振動、非線性振動、振動量測、振動抑制及隔離技術、振動與波之傳播、聲音之反射及折射、噪音之降低及吸音材料、消音器與噪音控制、法規及環境等。
description.en: Topics include: Mechanical vibration, Vibration transmission, Vibration measurement, The use of vibration isolators and absorbers, Fundamentals of acoustics, Noise control engineering, Instrumentation and Law.

interdisciplinary: 鐵道車輛系統學程

description.en: Equation of Motion, Single-Degree-of-Freedom Vibration (Free and Forced),Measurement of Vibrations, Two-Degree-of-Freedom Vibration, Multiple-Degree-of-Freedom Vibration and its Applications in Mechanical Engineering.

description.en: Use Python 3 to lead students to understand the following topics, the difficulty has been adjusted, and it is suitable for students with zero foundation or non-information related subjects to learn:Data Processing / Deep Learning / Machine Vision.

description.zh: 本課程提供所有博士生共同參與研究討論的園地。將進行設計專題報告、專題演講、研究小組討論。
description.en: This course is a joint seminar for all the doctoral students, which will be progressed by paper presentation of special topics on design issues, giving lectures, and group meeting.

description.zh: 本課程介紹整合即時影像、即時音訊、實體裝置、及相關表演科技（如燈光控制、各類感應器應用等）之技術與應用實務，並藉由圖形化、物件導向程式設計系統，引導未有程式設計經驗的視覺設計者或輔助已有程式設計能力者，以更有效率的方式進行相關互動系統設計，藉以達成互動裝置、表演科技、與表演藝術之整合。
description.en: This course introduces the technology that help integrates real-time video, audio, installations, and associated performance arts technology (such as lighting control, the application of various types of sensors, etc.) into performing arts. Through a graphical, object-oriented programming system, the course is intended to help visual designers with no programming experiences or to assist experienced programmers to efficiently design the interactive systems that combine interactive installations, performance arts technology, and performing arts itself as a whole.

name.en: Interactive Installation and Performing Arts Technology

notes: 日碩,外碩,設計博合開,排一般教室,限30人修

description.zh: 以圖像語言的架構教授分析性繪圖 (Analytical Drawing Process) 的概念與操作，以及分析性繪圖在設計速寫上的應用。課程以課堂講解與實地速寫來進行，主題包括感知與理解層面的三維觀察與紀錄、圖解、與圖像筆記。教學目標為：1.介紹分析性繪圖與徒手草寫。2.訓練以徒手草寫的過程來觀察、分析、與記錄結構、空間、與建成環境的三維特性。3.熟悉感知與理解的圖學系統與速寫表現手法，能以圖像筆記來記錄設計主題。
description.en: This course introduces the concept of analytical drawing process, and how to utilize it in design sketching.The objectives are:1.Introduce the concept of analytical drawing process and techniques of freehand sketch.2.Develop the ability to see and analyze the three-dimensional characteristics of an observed object and encountered environment through analytical drawing process.3.Familiar with both conceptual and perceptual form of representation, and be able to take a visual note to document an investigated subject.

notes: 日碩,外碩,設計博合開,預選開放13人,排光華409

description.zh: 本課程探討人工智慧(AI)與工程應用相關議題，並討論其解決方案與技術發展趨勢。內容由淺入深，包含基礎python程式設計、資料預處理、資料探索、機器學習、深度學習、AI工程應用介紹(分子性質預測、設備預測性維護、混凝土強度預測，PM2.5預測、房價預測等案例應用分析)及專題製作。在本課程中，學生可了解AI之基本原理及AI在工程上的應用，本課程也藉由AI程式撰寫的實作實習，提昇工程背景學生撰寫與理解AI應用程式設計的技能，以幫助學生將人工智慧導入產業應用實務中。
description.en: This course will introduce artificial intelligence (AI) and its applications in engineering fields. Topics covered include basic python programming, data prepossessing, data exploration, machine learning, deep learning, AI applications in engineering fields (e.g. predicting molecular properties, predictive maintenance predicting compressive strength of concrete, prediction of PM2.5, and prediction of house price, etc.) and final project. Students can learn about the basic principles and engineering applications of AI. Coding will be required to improve their programming competence in AI. The course intends to help the students implement AI concepts in their industrial practices.

description.zh: 對無機化合物之結構，化學性質等，利用量子化學，群論及結晶化學等加以探討。以配合天然礦物之形成，產狀，地球化學及環境化學等學科之授課內容。
description.en: The chemical structure and properties of inorganic compounds, which are useful for the following courses: the forming and occurrence of minerals, earth and environmental chemistry, will be discussed by using quantum chemistry, group theory and crystallography.

description.zh: 本課程從礦物的化學成分、化學鍵及其晶體結構之理論詳細討論礦物的物理及化學性質。再就各項理化性質在選礦、冶煉、化工製造及其它物理加工等方面之應用分別舉例介紹。
description.en: Systematic Study of physical and chemical properties of minerals, and relationships of properties with chemical compositions, chemical bonding mechanisms and crystal structures. Application examples are introduced in the fields of mineral processing, metal extraction, chemical industry, etc..

description.zh: 本課程著重在奈米材料的合成以及鑑定，包含氣相反應以及溶液相反應。課程核心內容為：(1)各式溶液相合成奈米粉末、中空奈米球以及奈米線(2)氣相反應合成奈米管、奈米線(3)分子轉印技術(4)奈米材料檢測技術
description.en: This course will cover the syntheses and characterization of various nanomaterials. The core lectures include:1. syntheses of nanoparticles, hollow nanospheres and nanowires from solutions2. syntheses of nanowires and nanotubes from the gas phase3. molecular imprinting4. characterization and properties of nanomaterials

interdisciplinary: 奈米科技學程

description.zh: 本課程介紹工程相關之主要數值分析方法及其於大地工程之應用，如有限差分法及有限元素法。透過實例問題之解析，使學生除了具有理論的基礎外，同時有能力藉著數值分析方法來分析大地工程問題。
description.en: This course introduces two representative numerical methods, i.e. finite difference method and finite element method, and their application to geotechnical engineering. Practical engineering problem are illustrated and simulated by numerical methods in the courses. It aims to train the students to be familiar with either the theorem of numerical analysis or the application to engineering practices.

description.zh: 地質工程為一新興科學，原來為解決全球變遷等大尺度問題而提出。基本上可以土木及環境工程兩大方面。本課程將從地質背景出發，結合工程問題及其處理對策，提供學生一個整合性的思考及基礎的地質知能。
description.en: Geoengineering is planetary-scale environmental engineering, particularly engineering aimed at counteracting the undesired side effects of other human activities. Geoengineering covers a wide range of engineering disciplines related to geo-materials, such as foundation engineering, slope engineering, tunnelling, rock engineering, engineering geology and geo-environmental engineering. This course interests range from geological to geomorphological concept, to provide a firm fundamental background for the civil engineering and environmental engineering, and to manage and mitigate of natural hazards. Implicit in these pursuits is the stewardship of the earth, and the quest to harvest the most advanced fruits of scientific achievements as tools for our graduates to work with.

interdisciplinary: 房屋結構安全性能評估微學程

description.zh: 環境生態學主要講述基本生態學之原理原則，進而應用於土木建設工程的方式主要內容包含：(1)環境生態系統、(2)生態學之基本法則、(3)質與能傳遞、(4)汙染物對生態之影響、(5)台灣地區之生態保育、(6)工程開發生態系統造成之影響、(7)環境影響評估、(8)交通及營建工程之環境問題、(9)全球環境變遷、(10)環境品質與法規。

Improper usage of resources will bring a serious disaster from the natural feed back. Construction should take care of the ecology system and the methods of carefulness would be studied in this course.

Seismic design of offshore wind turbines, 4. Wind resistance design of offshore wind turbines, 5. Wave resistance design of offshore wind turbines, 6. Fatigue design of supporting structures, 7. Case studies of steel structure design for supporting structures, 8. Case studies of concrete structure design for supporting structures, 9. Footing design of offshore wind turbines

description.zh: 伴隨著台灣經濟高度發展， 地下水資源在民生、工業及民生用水所扮演的角色日益重要。地下水學科的領域涵蓋水量、水質及防災三方面。修習此課程，學生可以了解地下水文及水井水力學之基本原理，推估區域性地下水蘊藏量及安全出水量，以作為規劃與管理地下水資源之依據。
description.en: As the economy in Taiwan develops, groundwater resources play an increasingly important role in both industry and domestic water supply. The discipline of groundwater covers three aspects: water quantity, water quality and disaster prevention. This course mainly introduces the basic principles of groundwater hydrology and well hydraulics, and tackles how to estimate the amount of regional groundwater resources and determine their safe yield, as a basis for planning and managing groundwater resources.

description.zh: 本課程包含「職業教育與訓練」及「生涯規劃」兩大主題。在「職業教育與訓練」部份，針對職業教育與訓練做整體性介紹，促使學生瞭解我國技職教育重要政策與特色、認識我國技職教育之設置群科、建立學生從事技職教育教學之基礎。在「生涯規劃」部份，針對除了加強學生自我覺察與職涯規劃，也增進學生未來任教時，協助自己的學生進行職涯探索與規劃的能力。教育專業課程與教師專業素養指標，請參閱連結: https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw
description.en: This course involves "Vocational Education and Training" and "Career Planning" two main topics. The "Vocational Education and Training" topic offers an introduction about vocational education and training, such as (a) flexible adjustment the system of vocational education and training in Taiwan; (b) emphasizing vocation education and training system; (c) establish solid theoretical foundation of the vocational education and training. The "Career Planning" topic offers an introduction to the concept of career to not only enhance students' self-awareness and the skills of career planning, but also use those skills to assist their future students to prepare their career planning.Indicators of Teacher’s professional competencies in professional education, please visit the link: https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw

description.en: The object of this course is to introduce the educational psychology to the students who are receiving teacher education. It presents the students with the basic psychology theories of instructional process; mental-physical development; the principles of learning and instruction; cultivating of thinking and creative; motivation and interest in instructing process; the measurement of individual difference; proper instructions against differently mental students; teacher-student relationship and students behaviors; instruction evaluation. After finishing this course, students will have better understanding regarding the factors shaping the students’ behaviors, as well as can choose the best instructional ways for the teaching.Indicators of Teacher’s professional competencies in professional education, please visit the link: https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw

description.zh: 「輔導工作是所有教育工作者的責任」。任何人都會遭遇問題，成長中的學生尤其有各式各樣的問題。身為人師，在教學過程中應輔導學生解決問題，以培養健康進取，有能力解決問題，適應環境的學生為己任。在本課程的目標即在透過對青春期挫折徵候的了瞭以及學者心理分析輔導法、個體心理輔導法、存在主義輔導法、理情輔導法、認知輔導法、溝通分析輔導法、行為輔導法等輔導理論，並配合實例分析使未來之教育工作人員獲得工作時的輔導知能以及培養輔導工作的志趣。教育專業課程與教師專業素養指標，請參閱連結:https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw
description.en: The teachers should keep in mind the duty to guide students to overcome the frustration or to solve difficult problems as to nurture students to be healthy, positive, with their own abilities to overcome difficulties and to be apt to the environment. The object of this subject is to help students with the willingness to be teachers get the knowledge and abilities of guidance on their teaching in the future, and develop willingness and interests of guidance. This course presents students with the units including understanding the symptom of adolescent frustration, the method of person-center approach, the method of rational-emotive therapy, the method of cognitive therapy, the method of behavior therapy. In addition, this course also introduces many practical cases so that students can effectively study the relevant theories.Indicators of Teacher’s professional competencies in professional education, please visit the link: https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw

description.zh: 本課程探討電子材料性質、固態物理基礎、元件物理等相關內容，強化電子材料與半導體元件技術之關聯性，藉由剖析材料結構與元件電性，深入探討電子元件在實際應用時可能遭遇之材料議題。本課程將介紹多種半導體元件技術應用，內容包括p-n接面、發光二極體與太陽能電池等。
description.en: This course will introduce the material properties, the basics of solid-state physics, and semiconductor devices and physics to provide knowledge of electronic materials and modern semiconductor devices. To assess the material and device issues of electronics for practical use, analysis of the material structure and electrical performance are essential. The content will include various semiconductor device technologies, such as p-n junction, light emitted diodes (LEDs), and solar cells.

description.en: The laser is one of the three major items invented in 20th century. Medical laser applications have been widely used in many fields. This lecture will cover: 1. Laser Physics; 2. Safety Standards; 3. Laser-Tissue-Interaction; 4. Laser in Medical Applications; 5. Laser in Periodontology; 6. Laser in Oral Surgery; 7. Laser Assisted Bleaching; 8. Low Level Laser Therapy; 9. Practical Hands-on and Live Patient Demonstration.

description.zh: CAD套裝軟體介紹、CAD數值技巧、二維畫圖、三維畫圖、曲面模型、實體模型建立、動畫之製作、最佳化設計、整合性之CAD系統及專題。
description.en: Introduction of CAD software package. Review of Numerical technique for CAD.2-D Graphics, 3-D Graphics, surface modeling, solid modeling. Design optimization, Integrated CAD systems and Animation project.

description.zh: 先修課程：無。本實習內容為汽車引擎實習，包含汽油及柴油引擎拆裝，引擎實驗，引擎量測與調整，點火、燃油、冷卻及潤滑系統之檢測及故障排除，定期調諧保養及引擎排氣檢測。
description.en: Automobile Engine Service Shop Practice ,Gasoline & Diesel Engine Assembly, Engine Test, Engine Tune-up and Repair, Trouble-shooting and Instrument Adjustment on: Ignition System, Fuel System, Cooling System, Lubrication System, and Starting System, Routine Engine Tune-Up and Engine Exhaust Emission Check .

description.zh: 本課程著重於中英文口頭報告能力之培養，在模擬發表過程中，培養學生使用正確的表達用法，並建立適當之應對方式。
description.en: This course offers opportunities for students to develop their oral presentation skills in both Chinese and English languages via simulated presentations in class. Students will learn how to present their papers precisely and how to engage a conversation properly.

description.zh: 本課程為財務會計領域之進階課程，針對已具初級會計學之學生深入講授財務會計之理論、觀念、方法及程序。本課程全面納入國際財務報導準則(IFRS)，內容包括：介紹財務報導觀念架構、主要財務報表編製、講解資產負債表中有關資產、負債、股東權益以及現金流量表與租賃會計等，修習本課程可使學生對IFRS有全面整體了解及運用之能力。亦有助於將來參加會計乙級、記帳士及公務人員高考等證照考試。
description.en: This course is an advanced course for financial accounting. It is to teach the financial accounting theory, concept, method and procedure for students with some basic accounting knowledge. The course covers all the materials to understand financial accounting based on IFRS. The course will help students for preparing advanced license examinations for accounting.

description.zh: 本課程所為研究所課程，內容包括主動煞車控制系統介紹，將針對ABS, TCS, ESP 及 SBC 煞車系統原理介紹，煞車系統及控制器之數學模式及設計等，應用實例介紹。
description.en: This course is designed mainly for senior/graduate students. The objective of this course is to introduce active braking control system, such as ABS, TCS, ESP and SBC background. The mathematical model of the system and its applications for the controller design of braking system are also included.

description.zh: 本課程介紹有限元素分析法基本原理及其在各種工程問題上之應用。包含有限元素分析法之基本觀念，利用變分原理建立有限元素模式，形狀函數及等參數元素，一維問題：桿、桁架、樑及骨架等，二維問題：平面應力應變及板殼問題。三維問題：一般實體，有限元素分析之計算機程式處理，有限元素分析於動態問題之應用，相關有限元素分析套裝軟體簡介
description.en: Introduction to the finite element method and its application to engineering problems. Topics include Variational Formulation and Finite Element Formulations, 1-D, 2-D and 3-D Element Shapes, Numerical Integration, Applications to dynamic problem and Introduction to Commercial Finite Element Programs.

notes: 車輛所、機電博班及外生班合開,610電腦教室, 配合USR

description.zh: 本課程主要包含四部份，分別為基本有限差分法、流體力學與熱傳方程式的有限差分法應用、有限體積法、格點產生法。
description.en: This course comprises four parts. Part one is fundamentals of finite-difference methods. Part 2 is the application of finite-difference methods to the equations of fluid mechanics and heat transfer. Part 3 is finite-volume method. Part 4 is grid generation.

notes: 車輛所、機電博班及外生班合開

description.zh: 線性空間分析，狀態方程式及響應，可控制性及可觀測性，穩定性分析，狀態回授及估測，控制器設計及應用，觀測器設計及應用，非線性系統，時變系統，控制理論的應用
description.en: Linear space Analysis, State equation and Response, Controllability and Observability, Stability Analysis, State Feedback and Estimation, Controller Design and Applications, Observer Design and Applications, Nonlinear systems, Time varying Systems, Applications of Control theory

notes: 車輛所和能源車輛外生合開

description.zh: 本課程將從不同的金融服務領域應用幫助同學瞭解數位金融的發展以及生成式AI於金融科技之應用。本課程之教學目標包括：(1) 人工智慧跨域應用金融產品企劃與數位行銷：掌握虛擬通路與實體通路的差異與整合應用，導入通用式人工智慧搭配合適的使用者介面與體驗設計；(2) 智慧金融科技素養與創新應用：關注大數據、雲端運算、物聯網與人工智慧的各種創新應用，並了解機器學習於資金管理之應用與人工智慧於量化交易之應用；(3) 生成式AI導入與開發：透過課程整合微軟Azure Open AI雲端服務資源，讓學生具有導入ChatGPT及聊天機器人開發能力，並連結創新創業課程建立明確創業目標，導入跨領域創業課程，養成專業職能和研發實力，進而了解金融產業在數位轉型中，所面臨的困難與挑戰。
description.en: 英文概述English Description This course will help students understand the development of digital finance and the application of generative AI in financial technology from different financial service applications. The objectives of this program include: (1) Financial product planning and digital marketing; (2) Intelligent financial technology literacy and innovative applications; (3) Generative AI Introduction and Development: Integrate Microsoft Azure Open AI cloud service resources through the course to provide students with the ability to introduce ChatGPT and chat robot development, and link to innovative entrepreneurship courses to establish clear entrepreneurial goals and introduce cross-disciplinary entrepreneurship courses to develop professional functions and R&D capabilities.

name.zh: 人工智慧跨域金融之應用

interdisciplinary: 人工智慧賦能跨域應用微學程

description.zh: 「新興支付應用暨產業發展」是一門探討現今支付產業趨勢的課程，課程內容包括了第三方電子支付、行動支付、跨領域支付應用、先買後付（Buy Now Pay Later, BNPL）及加密貨幣支付等。同時課程也會探討其產業發展脈絡、業者策略及監管等相關議題
description.en: This course explores current payment industry trends. The course content includes third-party electronic payments, mobile payments, cross-domain payment applications, Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL), and encrypted currency payments. At the same time, the course will also explore related issues such as industry development context, operator strategies, and regulation.

name.zh: 新興支付應用暨產業發展
name.en: Emerging Payment Applications and Industry Development

description.zh: 1.晶體學基礎2.張量的基本知識3.晶體之彈性性質4.介電晶體之電學性質5.晶體之傳統光學性質6.外場作用下晶體之光性7.晶體之非線性光學性質8.晶體物性測試
description.en: 1.Fundamental crystallography2.Introduction to tensor3.Elastic properties of crystal4.Electrical properties of Dielectrical crystal5.Traditional optical properties of crystal6.Optical properties of crystal in the applied field7.Non-linear optical properties of crystal8.Characterication of crystal physical properties

notes: 請安排六教小教室(修課人數上限20)

description.zh: 本課程以文化人類學的角度引導學生認識田野調查的發展背景，與當代社會科學研究中的應用現況。本課程分為田野調查相關理論介紹、田野調查的方法與倫理、大眾民族誌作品研讀與分析與田野調查實習三部份。透過基礎概念建立，搭配研讀相關作品，進一步思考田野調查之相關議題，最後依照擬定之田野調查場域或主題，進行實務操作練習，包含觀察、口訪與反思，並於期末進行分享與討論。
description.en: This course introduces the theories of anthropology and development of fieldwork as a research method. The ways to conduct a fieldwork are taught in the class, include participant observation and interview, and further, a practical workshop of fieldwork is offered, as an opportunity to practice fieldwork design, field observation and interview by students.

interdisciplinary: 文化永續與社會創新-社會實踐微學程

description.zh: 瞭解台灣華語文教學現況與發展、全球華語文教學現況，使同學具備國際漢語教學先備知識與研究能力，包含對漢語的本體、中文習得與認知、教學理論與方法及現代教學工具運用能力。
description.en: To know the situation and development of Chinese teaching as second language in Taiwan, as well as in the whole world. Let the classmate have the international Mandarin teaching skills and knowledge also the search capability which including the essence of the Mandarin, Chinese learning and cognition, teaching theories and modern teaching tools operation capability.

name.en: Introduction to Teaching Chinese As a Foreign Language

description.zh: 電氣化軌道系統簡介，捷運系統演進，捷運系統概論，機電介面，電聯車，列車機械動態與界限，列車運動性能與電力負載，列車供電方式，牽引供電系統設計簡介，號誌系統，通訊系統簡介，機廠簡介。
description.en: Electrified Railway system introduction, Evolution of transit railway systems, Transit railway system structure, Vehicle electrical interfaces, Train-track dynamics, Train dynamic envelop, Vehicle power feeds, Traction power supply, Signaling Systems, Communication systems, Depot and maintenance shop introduction.

name.en: Introduction to Railroad Vehicle and Electrical System

notes: 電機三合開,限25人,綜科館216A階梯教室

description.en: 1.Spatial description transformation2.Manipulation kinematics3.Inverse manipulation kinematics4.Jacobians5.Trajectory generation6.Linear control of manipulator7.Machine vision8.Robotic obstacle avoidance9.Industrial automation applications10.Laboratory work: control of manipulators and mobile robots, automatic manipulation with vision sensors, navigation and control of mobile robots

工業4.0電資學程
人工智慧科技學程
光電智慧製造學程

人工智慧與深度學習微學程

description.zh: 中文簡介、單晶體與雙晶體放大器、藕合電路、差動放大器、電晶體電流源、主動元件與負載、匹配與偏壓電路、操作放大器、頻率響應、回授電路穩定度、非線性類比電路、電路雜訊、電阻佈局、電容佈局、二極體佈局、雙極性與場效電晶體佈局等。
description.en: English Description General Induction , Single-Transistor and Two-Transistor Ampligier，Coupled Circuit and Differential Amplifiers，Transister Current Sources and Active Loads，Matching and Biasing Circuits，Operational Ampligiers，Frequency response of Ics，Frequency Response and Stability of Feedback Amplifiers，Nonlinear Analog Circuits，Noise in IC Components and Circuit System，Resistor layout，Capacitor layout，Diode layout，Bipolar Transistor layout，CMOS Transistor layout。

description.zh: 各種時域響應之電腦繪圖，矩陣各項特性分析與應用，根值軌跡圖，波德圖，奈奎士圖，PID控制器之設計，Lead-Lag補償器之設計，控制器時域及頻域分析，控制器在狀態空間之設計，實例探討，書報研讀。
description.en: Course Title:Automatic Control PracticeDescription:This course is first to introduce the basic concepts ofcontrol systems and the mathematical background, second, state thetransfer function, block diagram and signal flow graph, third,discuss the mathematical modeling of control systems and elements, andforth, describe the time-domain analysis, root locus techniques andfrequency-domain of control systems, and then to measure the characterof control systems, Finally, the design of control system will beintroduced.

interdisciplinary: 電資_第二專長【電機系_自動控制】

description.zh: 本課程旨在教授學生瞭解雲端環境及物聯網系統架構並進一步教授雲端環境及物聯網安全需求，課程內容除介紹雲端環境及物聯網系統的基本概念外，亦將由OWASP的雲端安全及物聯網安全的重點進行說明，培養學生有能力分析雲端及物聯網環境中的各式潛在安全威脅，並具備設計與實作具安全防護能力的雲端及物聯網系統。
description.en: This course aims to teach students to understand the cloud environment and IoT system architecture. Furthermore, the teach of the cloud environment and IoT security requirements are also introduced. In addition to introducing the basic concepts of cloud environment and IoT system, the course content will also include OWASP cloud security and IoT security. The main objective is on developing students' ability to analyze various potential security threats in the cloud and IoT environments, as well as cloud and IoT systems that are designed and implemented with security protection capabilities.

notes: 資財四甲乙、資財所合開

description.zh: 物聯網系統包含了感測器與感測網路，邊緣閘道，雲端服務與存取裝置，可建構眾多的端到端商業應用包含無人商店與智慧支付的場景金融，遠距醫療與照護，智慧製造與智慧家庭等。本課程將教授物聯網系統的設計包含裝置與服務的技術，並以各項商業應用場景做課題的探討。
description.en: The Internet of Things (IoT) system encompasses sensors and sensor networks, IoT gateways, cloud services, and mobile devices, enabling the development of numerous end-to-end business applications, including scenarios such as unmanned stores, and intelligent payment in the financial sector, remote healthcare and caregiving, smart manufacturing, and smart homes. This course will teach the design of IoT systems, including device and service technologies, and explore various business application scenarios as topics of discussion.

name.zh: 物聯網系統設計與商業應用
name.en: IoT System design and Business Application

notes: 資財四甲乙、資財所合開

description.zh: 本課程銜接上學期程式交易課程內容(限定修過上學期的同學才能選修)，我們將使用R語言進行更為精實的交易策略建構，包刮K棒分析、指標建構、訊號探勘、資金管理…等。此外，我們下半學期將邀請業師教授XQ程式交易軟體，撰寫XS程式語法進行回測以及模擬下單
description.en: This course connects with the last semester courses “program trading” (limited to last semester students to join). We will use the R language for more sophisticated trading strategy construction, including K-bar analysis, index construction, trading signal exploration, money management, and so on. In addition, we will invite the instructor to teach XQ program trading software in the last half-semester, usingXS program grammar to back-testing trading strategies.

description.zh: 本課程內容包括：Android作業系統概觀、Java程式設計簡介、Android SDK應用程式開發環境與模擬器建置、Android專案建立與結構、Activity元件、使用者介面設計與使用XML的方式、View與Layout、Widget與使用者事件處理方法、Dialogs、Adapter與AdapterView、WebView、儲存媒介元件、多媒體撥放器元件、定位系統元件、Google Maps、加速感測器元件等等。
description.en: The topics included in this course will include: Android operating system overview, A brief introduction of Java, Android SDK development environment setup and the emulator, Android project creation, Activity, User interface design and XML, View and layout, Widget and event handling, Dialogs, Adapter and AdapterView, Webview, Storage, Mediaplayer, GPS, Google Maps, G-sensor, etc.

description.zh: 簡介，感測器，基本驅動器，順序及計時控制，PLC，伺服驅動器及放大器，基本伺服控制系統。
description.en: Course Title:Mechatronics PracticeDescription:To familiarize students with the usage of mechatronictechniques and corresponding parts/components

interdisciplinary:
智慧節能電源科技微學程
太空科技微學程

description.zh: 以結構工程、大地工程、防災科學、運輸交通、營建管理、營建材料及營建技術為專題討論主題之主要範疇。
description.en: SeminarSpecial subject discussion of structure engineering , geography engineering pretecting calamity science, transportation, construction management , construction material and construction technique.

description.zh: 這門課著重在探討奈米科技之基本原理與應用範疇，以及環境應用與安全相關主題，內容包含奈米之基本特性、各種量測方法、結構控制、以及"納米"對環境應用與安全問題。此外並包含奈米微粒之產生、收集、測量以及微粒動力學等主題。
description.en: This course will investigate the definition and theories of nanotechnology. Including basic properties, measuring methods, structural control, environmental, and safety issues of "Nano-". Topics about generation, collection, measurement and dynamics of nano-particle will also be covered.

name.en: Special Topics on Nano- Technology and Environment

description.zh: 本課程主要在於介紹產品環保化設計的概念與實務做法，將會詳細介紹生命週期評估的內涵與原理做法，並將透過軟體的實際作來學期如何從事產品的生命週期評估。簡化式的生命週期評估之作法也會在課堂中被介紹。
description.en: This course focuses on introducing the meaning and principles of designing environmentally sound products. The theories and principles of Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) will be introduced extensively. Several sets of LCA computer software will be utilized in the classes for students to practice. Besides, the streamlined LCA (SLCA) will also be taught in the class.

interdisciplinary: 循環經濟與淨零永續微學程

description.zh: 本課程主要教授學生：(1)橋梁之功能及組織、(2)橋梁之種類、(3)橋梁之上部結構、(4)橋梁之下部結構：(a)基礎(b)橋台(c)橋墩、(5)橋梁之伸縮設施、(6)橋面排水設施、(7)欄杆及照明設施、(8)跨海大橋、陸橋、高架橋及跨河大橋等簡介。
description.en: Planning,desing,constroution and maintenance of the various bridges.

notes: 土木四(20人)及防災所合開(20人) 土木106

description.zh: 許多現成的工程軟體並無法滿足所有客製化的需求，因此會開放作謂的「應用程式介面」（Application Programming Interfaces, API）供使用者進行二次開發，使其能自行拼湊、重組與創造需要的功能。本課程以建築資訊塑模（BIM）或人工智慧（AI）應用為主要示範案例，訓練學生有系統地理解API的規格說明文件，並且有效率地開發API應用程式，以達到各種工程應用軟體的客製化應用，並提升不同軟體間的交互操作性。
description.en: Many engineering software packages may not fully meet all customized requirements, thus they provide Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) for users to engage in secondary development. This course takes Building Information Modeling (BIM) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications as primary demonstration examples, and trains the enrolled students to systematically understand API documentations as well as efficiently develop API applications. It can help the enrolled students to customize their software for solving the engineering problems. In addition, it also enhances the interoperability between different engineering software packages.

name.zh: 工程軟體API應用程式開發
name.en: API Development for Engineering Computer Software

description.zh: 1. 混凝土結構概述與支撐結構混凝土材料特性, 2. 支撐結構設計載重與材料強度規定, 3. 離岸風機地震載重設計, 4. 離岸風機風載重設計, 5. 離岸風機波浪載重設計, 6. 支撐結構之疲勞設計, 7. 支撐結構之鋼結構設計與案例, 8. 支撐結構之混凝土結構設計與案例, 9. 離岸風機基礎設計
description.en: 1. Concepts of concrete structures and concrete material properties, 2. Loads and material strength required for designing supporting structures, 3. Seismic design of offshore wind turbines, 4. Wind resistance design of offshore wind turbines, 5. Wave resistance design of offshore wind turbines, 6. Fatigue design of supporting structures, 7. Case studies of steel structure design for supporting structures, 8. Case studies of concrete structure design for supporting structures, 9. Footing design of offshore wind turbines

name.en: Introduction to Theory and Applications in Wind Engineering

description.zh: 認識坡地災害，包括全球性的原因與台灣地區特有的自然因素、人為因素及坡地災害現，進而討論坡地災害防治的原則及方法。1.坡地災害防治的重要性 2.坡地災害的全球性原因 3.台灣的削平速率與山坡地崩坍概況 4.台灣地區最脆弱的坡地 5.台灣地區坡地災害的自然動力 6.坡地災害的人為因素 7.坡地破壞之前兆 8.坡地災害防治一般性原則 9.坡地災害防治所必需的基本資料 10.坡地災害的防治與復育技術 11.坡地災害的緊急救治方法 12坡地災害個案分析

description.zh: 本課程將以BIM之觀點，介紹國內外建築資訊模型及建築資訊模型案例，包含建築資訊模型及探討BIM之設計與實作，希望學生能夠由設計一個資訊系統開始，瞭解BIM建築資訊系統之架構與應用，進而實際開發一個BIM相關資訊系統，其內容包括：建築資訊模型營建自動化應用，建築資訊模型實務應用，國內外建築資訊模型案例探討，建築資訊模型元件分析與設計，BIM程式撰寫，BIM系統之設計與實作等內容。
description.en: Building Information Modeling (BIM) is increasingly important for engineering and management applications, functions and decision-making. The course introduces the BIM use, modeling, design, and development of BIM-related application in the lifecycle of construction projects. The course is a combination of lectures, readings, hands-on exercises, homework assignments and a project. The course allows students to develop a BIM-related application suitable to their own research or professional inteests.
