description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意本課程介紹如何應用數值分析理論求解工程問題。1. 數值方法基本觀念及其領域2. 數值方法之誤差及穩定性3. 非線性代數方程式之數值解法4. 聯立代數方程式之數值解法5. 矩陣特徵值求法6. 非線性聯立方程式之數值解法7. 多項式插值法及曲線配湊8. 數值微分與積分9. 常微分方程式之數值解法10. 偏微分方程式之數值解法
description.en: To introduce the numerical analysis techniques for solving engineering problems.1. Introduction to the basic concepts of the numerical analysis2. The errors and stability of the numerical methods3. Numerical methods of solving nonlinear algebraic equations4. Numerical methods of solving systems of linear equations.5. Algebraic eigen-value problems6. Numerical methods of solving systems of nonlinear equations7. Numerical interpolation and curve fitting8. Numerical differentiation and integration9. Numerical solution of ordinary differential equations10. Numerical solution of partial differential equation

notes: 製科所、機電博班及外生班合開,限20人

description.zh: UX（User Experience）使用者經驗設計師，是一種特別需要橫向與縱向技能的設計師。本課程從物件 (objects) 、流程 (processes)、體驗 (experiences)、敘事(narratives) 四個不同的脈絡切面，讓學生了解使用者經驗設計師的必備知識、技能與工具。並隨著生成式AI的趨勢，介紹生成式AI如何輔助UX設計師進行使用者研究與設計。同時，培養學生未來能在特定專業領域持續發展使用者體驗設計師職能的視野和態度，以及UX設計師在職場上的角色定位。 學生將學會結合使用者研究的質性和量化方法及其工具來塑造實體與數位產品或服務的資訊架構。此外，他們將掌握如何利用簡報和視覺化溝通來促進組織內的設計決策。課程將涵蓋UX、LEAN UX、Agile UX與Scrum等不同設計開發流程的實踐。學生也會學習Prototype設計規劃與實施易用性測試，使用實體與遠端工具。課程中也將介紹如何運用生成式AI輔助UX研究與設計。
description.en: UX (User Experience) designers require both broad and specialized skills. This course provides students with a comprehensive understanding of the necessary knowledge, skills, and tools for UX designers through the context of four different aspects: objects, processes, experiences, and narratives. Students will learn to integrate qualitative and quantitative user research methods and tools to shape the information architecture of both physical and digital products or services. Additionally, they will master how to use presentations and visual communication to facilitate organizational design decisions. The course covers practical processes of various design development workflows, such as UX, LEAN UX, Agile UX, and Scrum. Students will also learn prototype design planning and how to conduct usability testing with both physical and remote tools. The course will also illustrate the use of generative AI in assisting UX research and design.

name.zh: UX設計師的練功房和他的武器室
name.en: Mastering UX: The Designer's Dojo and Armory

description.zh: UX（User Experience）使用者經驗設計師，是一種特別需要橫向與縱向技能的設計師。本課程從物件 (objects) 、流程 (processes)、體驗 (experiences)、敘事 (narratives) 四個不同的脈絡切面，讓學生了解使用者經驗設計師的必備知識、技能與工具。學生將學會結合使用者研究的質性和量化方法及其工具來塑造實體與數位產品或服務的資訊架構。另一方面，本課程也深入探討UX於學術研究上的趨勢，讓學術與實務層面兼備。此外，學生將掌握如何利用簡報和視覺化溝通來促進組織內的設計決策，並學習Prototype設計規劃與實施易用性測試，使用實體與遠端工具。課程中也將介紹如何運用生成式AI輔助UX研究與設計。
description.en: User experience designers are designers who particularly require horizontal and vertical skills. This course allows students to understand the necessary knowledge, skills, and tools of user experience designers from four different aspects: objects, processes, experiences, and narratives. Students will learn to combine qualitative and quantitative methods and tools of user research to shape the information architecture of physical and digital products or services. In addition, students will master how to use briefings and visual communication to promote design decisions within the organization and learn to prototype design planning and implement usability testing using physical and remote tools. The course will also introduce how to use generative AI to assist UX research and design. On the other hand, this course also profoundly explores the trends of UX in academic research, integrating both academic and practical aspects.

name.zh: 使用者經驗研究與實務

description.zh: 本課程以實踐機器人和人工智慧應用為核心，採用美國麻省理工學院（MIT）的專案任務導向學習模式。透過結合講授、討論、實際應用和案例分析，課程將會幫助學生深入理解人工智慧和機器人技術。學生有機會積極參與小組項目，透過情境思考實際應用所學知識，並親自操作機器學習工具和機器人平台，以培養實際技能。
description.en: This course is designed for the practical application of robotics and artificial intelligence (AI). It adopts the project-based learning model inspired by the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT). The course combines lectures, discussions, and case studies to give students an in-depth understanding of AI technology and robotic applications. Students can engage in group projects, apply their knowledge in real-world scenarios, and gain hands-on experience with machine learning tools and mobile robot platforms.

name.zh: AI探索者: AI 與高階機器人控制
name.en: Application of AI and Advanced robot control systems

description.zh: 當代都市議題經常為跨領域、開放性的複雜問題，在資料蒐集與分析上，需要整合地理空間、時間的維度；在分析與對策上，須平衡公部門、私部門、民眾等多重利害關係者的，是一門相當複雜但重要的學問。本課程從真實的都市議題出發，教導學生掌握地理空間資訊、資料分析、資料建模、資訊視覺化、策略論述等綜合能力，培養學生對於都市複雜議題的觀察與剖析，進而對真實環境提出洞見與創意。
description.en: Contemporary urban issues are complex, requiring the integration of geographical, and temporal dimensions in data collection and analysis. Balancing the interests of stakeholders like the public, and private sectors is crucial. This course focuses on real urban issues, teaching skills in geographical information, data analysis, modeling, visualization, and strategic discourse. It aims to cultivate students' ability to observe, analyze urban issues, and propose insights for real environments. It's an advanced course, requiring basic programming and GIS concepts. Through group projects, students learn API usage, geographic computation, model building, and data visualization. The course includes one midterm report and one final project report.

name.zh: 都市數據進階分析與模型應用
name.en: Advanced Urban Data Analytics and Modeling

description.zh: 本課程旨在探索人工智能機器人對城市發展的正面影響。學生將掌握機器人技術的基礎，並通過實作、實驗與團隊合作，定義都市所面臨的挑戰並設計出解決方案的機器人原型，並學會如何運用所學知識解決實際問題。
description.en: This course is designed to delve into the transformative role of artificial intelligence (AI) robots in shaping the future of urban development. Participants will gain foundational knowledge in robotics, engaging in hands-on projects, experiments, and collaborative efforts to pinpoint and tackle urban challenges. Through the creation of robotic prototypes, students will not only devise innovative solutions but also learn the practical application of their theoretical knowledge to real-world problems. This curriculum encourages a deep understanding of how AI can contribute positively to urban environments, equipping students with the skills to make impactful changes in the field of urban development.

description.zh: 使用 Unity 3D 建立專業的 VR/AR/MR 應用程序，Unity 3D 是一款功能強大的跨平台 3D 引擎，可提供用戶友好的開發環境。 在本課程中，學生將學習如何從頭開始建立 VR 引擎，以便學生充分了解從 3D 模型到 VR 顯示器中的像素的整個3 D圖形顯現管道。 學生還將學習如何在 Unity 中實現最重要的 VR 互動概念，例如選擇、操作、旅行、尋路、選單和文字輸入。學生在本課程中學到的 VR/AR/MR 程式設計知識將有助於學生編寫 VR/AR/MR 遊戲、建築演練、工程模擬、3D 數據檢視器、醫療培訓應用程式等。
description.en: Build professional VR/AR/MR apps using Unity 3D, a powerful cross-platform 3D engine that provides a user-friendly development environment. In this course, students will learn how to build a VR engine from the ground up, so students fully understand the entire rendering pipeline from 3D model to pixels in the VR display. Students will also learn how to implement the most important VR interaction concepts such as selection, manipulation, travel, wayfinding, menus, and text input in Unity.What students learn about VR/AR/MR programming in this course will help students write VR/AR/MR games, architectural walkthroughs, engineering simulations, 3D data viewers, medical training applications, and many more.

description.zh: 本課程主要教授與計算生物學及醫學資訊學相關之重要主題。 學生能夠了解如何正確分析生物和醫學數據所衍伸的問題及應用。 希望透過課程協助同學了解和學習如何組裝基因體資料和醫學數據分析中經常使用的演算法技術內容，閱讀最新相關生醫技術論文及使用開放工具，增進實際操作之經驗或自行建構分析生醫相關資料之應用系統。
description.en: This course is designed to provide important topics in computational biology and medical informatics. Students are able to learn about problems involved in the generation and analysis of biological and medical data. The course intends to provide good understanding of the commonly used algorithms and public tools in the analysis of genomic and medical data, to read updated scientific reports, and to increase hands-on experiences with accessing and using relevant databases.

name.zh: 計算生物學及醫學資訊

description.zh: 神經網路之簡介、直傳式神經網路、監督式學習、非監督式學習、回傳式神經網路、神經網路之結構分析、學習方式分析神經網路之應用。
description.en: Introduction to Networks, Feedback Neutral Networks ,Supervised Learning, Unsupervised Learning, Recurrant Neural Networks, Structure Analysis of Neural Networks, Analysis of Learning Methods, Applications of Neural Networks.

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意本課程介紹有限元素分析法基本原理及其在各種工程問題上之應用。1. 有限元素分析法之基本觀念2. 利用變分原理建立有限元素模式3. 形狀函數及等參數元素4. 一維問題:桿、桁架、樑及骨架等5. 二維問題:平面應力應變及板殼問題。6. 三維問題:一般實體7. 有限元素分析之計算機程式處理8. 有限元素分析於動態問題之應用9. 相關有限元素分析套裝軟體簡介
description.en: To introduce the basic principle of the finite element analysis and its application in solving various types of engineering problems.1. Introduction to the basic concepts of the finite element analysis2. Formulation of the finite models through the use of variational principles3. Shape functions and isoparametric elements4. One dimensional problems: rod, truss, beam, frame, etc.5. Two dimensional problems: plane stress, plane strain and plate, etc.6. Three dimensional problems: typical solids7. Implementation of the FEM computation by computer8. Finite element applications in dynamic problems9. Survey of some finite-element software systems

notes: 機電所和機械自動化外生班合開

description.zh: 遊戲化是一種能有效提升產品服務體驗的設計手段。本課程首先介紹遊戲化和行為設計的理論基礎，並透過參與式設計工作坊，結合遊戲機制於產品系統創新的開發過程。
description.en: Gamification is a technique that can stimulate users’ motivation and engagement in various non-game contexts such as education, business, health, workplace, and so on. This course is divided into two parts. The first part provides the theoretical background, consisting of the gamification definition/taxonomy, and behavioral design. In the second part of this course, students will organize a participatory design workshop to gain insights from the stakeholders to develop delightful products and services based on game mechanics.

description.zh: 專題演講或書報討論
description.en: In this course, we will invite speakers from the academia, industry and government to lectures on topics in computer science and information engineering.

description.zh: 研究生在教授之個別指導下，針對特定研究主題進行研究 ，並將研究成果寫成論文。
description.en: Graduate students are required to complete a specific research topic under the instruction of their advisor(s). The results should be written as a thesis.

notes: 博士班二年級以上修讀

description.zh: 本課程主要目的在促進學生進一步瞭解檔案策展與加值應用之概念與方法，並著重於檔案典藏單位及其所典藏檔案之展示規劃及應用。透過本課程之授課內容，學生可培養以下幾個能力：（1）認識檔案策展之基本概念；（2）理解檔案加值應用之原則與倫理；（3）具備檔案評估、規劃及檔案資料應用之專業素養。
description.en: This course will introduce the basic concepts and practical issues in archives curating and value added. And then, focus on the exhibition planning and application of archives and archival material. By attending the class students will: (1) Understand basic concepts and methods of archives curation. (2) Gain in-deep understanding the principles and ethics of archives value added. (3) Possess the archival intelligence to use, evaluate and curate the archival material.

description.zh: 各式數位科技已被廣泛應用在各產業，本課程主要是介紹數位轉型、智慧製造與永續生產相關之課題及其相關技術。
description.en: Many digital technologies have been widely used in various industries. This course mainly introduces topics related to digital transformation, smart manufacturing and sustainable production, as well as related technologies.

description.zh: ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

name.en: English Communication and Application I (ECA Courses)

description.zh: 本課程著重教導學生閱讀文章，並藉由文章訓練學生字彙建構、語言解析及聽力會話、思維啟發能力。課中延展活動將閱讀內容與聽力、會話、寫作做進一步的連結，並引導學生將所學做有效的應用。
description.en: The course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in learning how to process, and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skills development, vocabulary building, language analysis, and thought-provoking discussions. The readings include a variety of viewpoints on global topics centered around social issues, the environment, psychology, business, and technology. Extension activities are designed to encourage students to go beyond the reading text, and to put what they acquire from the readings into listening, speaking and writing practices.

name.zh: 基礎英文閱讀與字彙(一)
name.en: Basic English Reading and Vocabulary I

description.zh: 本課程提供學生及職前專業人士必備之英語文語言技巧，強調機電專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分並整合英語文之聽說讀寫之能力為未來全球化移動及以英語專業溝通人才培育為目標。
description.en: This course aims to provide pre-service Mechanical & Electrical Engineering students/professionals with the adequate skills of the English language and communicative competence to facilitate their current academic and future career pursuits. Students are encouraged to utilize their domain expertise to participate in professional communication in English. Centered on the training of professional use of the English language, the ESP curriculum as the crux of a highly-integrated work of domain knowledge and the English learning development embodies the indispensable credentials required for a global profession.

description.zh: 本課程旨在帶領學生讀、理解並分析國際時事,提高學生之英文能力，透過對多元主體之解析，讓學生了解單字用法，句型結構，特殊術語和慣用俚語等，提升閱讀能力，另外配合聽力技巧學習，提升理解能力。本課程著重英文閱讀，聽力與口說能力，鼓勵學生以英文討論國際時事，發表見解，拓展對世界的認識。
description.en: This course intends to enhance students’ reading, speaking and listening abilities by using quality newspapers, journals, interviews and podcast. It will help students enrich their vocabulary and acquire key English expressions and sentence patterns used in different realms like politics, arts, entertainment, science & technology, sports, business and health. Students learn to read, discuss and debate global issues through diverse forms of activities. This course familiarizes students with world affairs and broadens their perspective of the world.

description.zh: 本課程旨在提升學生資訊領域的英語文能力，加強學生於該領域課堂學習與未來職業所需的閱讀與口說技巧。本課程中，學生將經由研讀資訊領域相關文章以及針對相關主題的討論，增加資訊領域的字彙，並加強英語能力與溝通技巧。
description.en: This course is designed for students who are interested in improving English skills in the field of information technology. It aims to increase students’ reading fluency and improve their speaking skills needed to function and succeed in classroom settings and in future career. In this course, authentic reading texts related to information technology will be used. Students will discuss topics, such as artificial intelligence and the World Wide Web, in order to expand vocabulary and language skills.

description.en: This course aims to enhance communicative competence with special emphasis on entrepreneurial thinking and professional English skills. From the perspectives of learning English for specific purposes (ESP) and entrepreneurship, students will learn how to create, rehearse and effectively participate in a range of different scenarios for current academic and future career pursuits.

name.en: English for Innovation and Entrepreneurship I

description.en: Because many people play, watch, and discuss sports every day, being able to talk about sports and to understand sports idioms is very helpful when interacting with English speakers. This course introduces students to English vocabulary that is useful for talking about sports, but also useful in other social situations. (For example, many sports idioms -- such as “to play hardball” and “to strike out” -- are used by businessmen in professional situations not directly related to sports). The class helps students to understand more clearly English news about sports, to talk more thoughtfully with English speakers about sports, and to think more critically about the important role that sports play in the culture, language, and everyday life of people in the English-speaking world.

description.zh: 透過不同主題的多媒體素材，素材包含電影片段/歌曲/影集片段/線上互動遊戲/演講/線上協作軟體等，藉由不同的活動設計（聽力練習、會話練習、議題討論、口頭報告等）增進學生聽說讀寫的能力。比起純粹只有紙本素材的練習，讓學生可以透過相當於實境互動的情境，而更有學習動機、了解語言運用的情況，以及有較具體的實例以英語討論問題。
description.en: In order to cultivate the students’ comprehensive capabilities to use English, especially the listening comprehension and oral expression ability, different multimedia materials, including movies, songs, TV series, online interactional games, online aiding software, etc., are used to help students understand when and how to use language appropriately in various situations. Different activities (listening practice, role-play, group discussion, and oral presentation) are designed to facilitate students’ English learning.

description.zh: 本課程旨在訓練學生能夠靈活運用旅行中會使用的英文，並了解觀光產業的發展及所需之英文溝通內容和能力。課程中透過主題討論，讓學生對於本國及全球觀光產業及事務有進一步的認識。
description.en: This course aims to enable students to use English confidently and effectively as professionals in tourism and hospitality industry. In this course, students will also learn about trends and development in the industry at the local and global level, and strengthen their English communicative competence.

description.zh: 本課程提供學生及職前專業人士必備之英語文語言技巧，強調設計專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分並整合英語文之聽說讀寫之能力為未來全球化移動及以英語專業溝通人才培育為目標。
description.en: This course aims to provide pre-service design students/professionals with the adequate skills of the English language and communicative competence to facilitate their current academic and future career pursuits. Students are encouraged to utilize their domain expertise to participate in professional communication in English. Centered on the training of professional use of the English language, the ESP curriculum as the crux of a highly-integrated work of domain knowledge and the English learning development embodies the indispensable credentials required for a global profession.

description.zh: 本課程旨在提升學生資訊領域的英語文能力，加強學生於該領域課堂學習與未來職業所需的閱讀與口說技巧。本課程中，學生將經由研讀資訊領域相關文章以及針對相關主題的討論，增加資訊領域的字彙，並加強英語能力與溝通技巧。
description.en: This course is designed for students who are interested in improving English skills in the field of information technology. It aims to increase students’ reading fluency and improve their speaking skills needed to function and succeed in classroom settings and in future career. In this course, authentic reading texts related to information technology will be used. Students will discuss topics, such as artificial intelligence and the World Wide Web, in order to expand vocabulary and language skills.

description.zh: 本課程提供學生及職前專業人士必備之英語文語言技巧，強調設計專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分並整合英語文之聽說讀寫之能力為未來全球化移動及以英語專業溝通人才培育為目標。

description.zh: 本課程旨在提升學生學術英文能力，課堂將引導學生透過不同的學術聽力訓練、閱讀學術文章、學術寫作練習、與學術口語訓練等，來增進學生於大學英語授課課堂中的課堂參與，以及整體學術能力的展現，並為未來專業職場上語言能力奠定良好基底。
description.en: This course is designed for undergraduate students to develop their academic English language skills for success in English-medium university coursework. This course will engage students with active participation in a variety of academic listening, reading, writing, and speaking activities that they would encounter in real-life academic university lectures and professional workplace environments.

description.zh: 本課主旨在培養學生職場英語文溝通能力，如提案、企劃案提寫、時事討論、公司產品行銷、書信寫作，希冀能夠藉由本課程之修習，加強學生進入職場前的競爭力。
description.en: This course is designed to provide students with a firm foundation in business communication skills. Students will learn how to present a proposal, start a discussion, and promote company products in English. It is hoped that by the end of this course, students are equipped with sufficient knowledge of general and business English.

description.zh: 本課主旨在設計課程，提供練習，俾使學生嫻熟各式的英語測驗，如全民英檢、托福測驗、TOEIC 測驗或類似性質的測驗，希冀能夠藉由本課程的修習，提升學生不斷的學習外國語的興致，並且，藉由通過考試取得證照，增加未來職場的競爭力。
description.en: This course is designed to familiarize the students with various kinds of language proficiency tests such as GEPT, TOEFL, TOEIC and many others to the same end. It is our hope that the students who finish taking the course will go on with their enthusiasm on studying foreign languages; besides, through the acquisition of the certificate when the students pass the tests, they are sure to enhance their capability in the increasingly competitive job markets.

description.zh: 本課程討論細胞培養與基因工程技術之原理與應用，課程內容包涵下列主題：(1) 微生物、植物、昆蟲及動物細胞之特性 (2)細胞於生物反應器的培養，包括各式生物反應器介紹、生物反應器動力學、生物反應器之操作與控制 (3)基因重組蛋白之表現，將包涵不同的細胞載体表現系統 (4)實例探討，如單株抗體、生物高分子材料、基因治療載体等之生產。
description.en: This course discusses the principle and applications of cell culture and molecular biology. The course covers the following topics: (1) characteristics of microbial, plant, insect, and mammalian cells; (2) cell culture in bioreactors, including descriptions of bioreactor types, operation modes, bioreactor kinetics, and instrumentation and control; (3) expression of foreign genes in various cell systems; (4) case studies, such as production of monoclonal antibody, biopolymers, and gene therapy vectors.

name.en: Special Topics in Molecular Cell Biology

interdisciplinary: 生醫材料學程

description.zh: 「太空軟體系統設計」課程旨在培養學生在太空任務中設計、開發和操作軟體系統的專業能力。學生將深入了解太空環境對軟體系統的特殊要求，包括真空、輻射、溫度等因素對系統性能的影響。課程將探討飛行軟體的設計和架構，學生將學習如何設計出能夠在極端條件下穩定運行的飛行軟體系統，確保太空任務的順利執行。此外，課程將涵蓋軟體驗證和確認技術，學生將學習如何確保軟體系統的功能性和安全性，並掌握各種測試方法和工具的應用。課程還將關注容錯和自我修復能力的設計，學生將學習如何設計具有容錯和自我修復功能的軟體系統，以應對可能的故障情況。最後，課程將介紹太空軟體系統的專案管理和實施，學生將學習如何有效地管理軟體開發專案，確保項目按時交付並符合品質標準。此外，課程還將包括深度學習在太空軟體系統中的應用，學生將探索如何利用深度學習技術來改進太空任務中的軟體系統設計和性能，以及酬載資料處理軟體的設計和開發，以支援太空任務中的資料收集和分析。通過本課程的學習，學生將具備設計和開發太空軟體系統所需的技能和知識，為未來在太空工程或相關領域的工作做好準備。
description.en: The course "Space Software System Design" aims to cultivate students' professional abilities in designing, developing, and operating software systems for space missions. Students will gain in-depth understanding of the special requirements that the space environment imposes on software systems, including the impact of factors such as vacuum, radiation, and temperature on system performance. The course will explore the design and architecture of flight software, teaching students how to design flight software systems that can operate stably under extreme conditions, ensuring the smooth execution of space missions. Additionally, the course will cover software verification and validation techniques, enabling students to ensure the functionality and safety of software systems and master various testing methods and tools.

description.zh: 太空科技應用課程旨在探討太空技術在各種應用領域的應用，與太空科技如何影響人類生活和科學研究。課程涵蓋的主題包括：太空探索，地球觀測，通訊和衛星導航，太空工程和材料科學，太空生物學和醫學，太空經濟和商業。通過這些主題的專題演講與小組討論，學生將了解太空科技在各個領域的應用和未來發展方向，並能夠掌握相關技術和知識。
description.en: The aim of the Space Science & Technology Seminar is to enable students to understand and master practical skills and knowledge in the field of space engineering, as well as to cultivate their teamwork, problem-solving, and innovative thinking abilities. Students will undertake a practical space engineering design project to understand the design, testing, implementation, and management processes of space engineering through practice, and demonstrate project outcomes through reports, presentations, and assessments. Through this course, students can understand the latest developments in the field of space engineering, master relevant skills and knowledge, and enhance their teamwork and project management abilities. This course can also provide practical exercises through industry-academia collaboration.

description.zh: 太空科技應用課程旨在介紹太空技術在各種應用領域的應用，並探討太空科技如何影響人類生活和科學研究。課程涵蓋的主題包括：太空探索，地球觀測，通訊和衛星導航，太空工程和材料科學，太空生物學和醫學，太空經濟和商業。通過這些主題的介紹，學生將了解太空科技在各個領域的應用和未來發展方向，並能夠掌握相關技術和知識。
description.en: The Space Technology Application Course aims to introduce the application of space technology in various fields, and explore how space technology impacts human life and scientific research. The course covers topics including space exploration, Earth observation, communication and satellite navigation, space engineering and materials science, space biology and medicine, and space economy and business. Through the introduction of these topics, students will understand the application of space technology in various fields and future development directions, and be able to master relevant technologies and knowledge.

name.zh: 深度學習與太空科技應用

description.zh: 衛星科技與工程導論的課程將介紹衛星系統及次系統基礎知識，以培養具有從事衛星任務設計之基礎能力。課程內容包括：衛星基本原理，衛星設計與製造，衛星運行與維護，衛星通訊與遙測應用，衛星發展趨勢。
description.en: The course "Introduction to Satellite Technology and Engineering" will introduce the basic knowledge of satellite systems and subsystems to cultivate the fundamental abilities needed for designing satellite missions. The course content includes: the basic principles of satellites, satellite design and manufacturing, satellite operation and maintenance, satellite communication and remote sensing applications, and satellite development trends.

name.en: Introduction to Satellite Technology and Engineering

description.zh: 人工智慧、5G行動通訊、雲端運算、區塊鏈、大數據、物聯網、無線區域網路、汽車電子、近場通訊、行動支付、智慧生活等，科技發展日新月異，便利你我的生活，但也助長了新的犯罪手段，專注新興科技的同時，資訊安全更要與時俱進。本課程將著重於資訊安全的基礎知識，以及對於現今通用的各種資訊安全觀念、技術、管理與應用給予整體性的認識，未來可進一步修習相關進階課程。
description.en: The rapid development of science and technology facilitates your life and mine, such as artificial intelligence, 5G mobile communication, cloud computing, blockchain, big data, Internet of Things, wireless local area network, vehicle electronics, near field communication, mobile payment, smart life, etc., but it also encourages new criminal methods. While focusing on emerging technologies, information security must move with the times. This course will focus on the basic knowledge of information security, giving whole understanding of various information security concepts, technologies, management and applications in common use today. In the future, students can further study related advanced courses.

description.zh: 這門課程著重於對立方衛星設計系統工程與實作的知識傳授，以全面了解整個系統整合與發展的過程。在這門課程中，學生將學習如何依衛星規格需求將系統分解為不同的子系統，如何將這些不同的子系統整合到一個完全功能的系統中，以及組裝整合完成後，如何進行測試與太空環境驗證流程。本課程由立方衛星EDM工程發展平台學習步驟組成，配備立方衛星課堂使用的衛星套件、元件講解。主要配備了六個主要子系統 – 衛星電力供應管理(EPS)、衛星命令和數據處理(C&DH)、衛星通訊次系統(TT&C)、衛星飛行軟體(F.S.W)、衛星姿態控制感測器(ADCS)和衛星結構(SMS)。通過體驗立方衛星組裝、整合（包括軟體編程和系統組裝）和測試的過程，學生可以了解每個衛星組件和次系統的功能，以及如何將各次系統整合到衛星系統中，最後進入衛星太空環境驗測，透過實務學習加深學生對衛星設計和開發的理解，以獲得寶貴的技能與知識。
description.en: This course puts it focus on establishing the knowledge of cubeSAT systems engineering by going through the whole process of system integration. During the course student will learn how the system is broken down into different subsystem (requirement), how to integrate those different subsystem (requirement) into a fully functioning system, and how to test/debug it once it has been integrated.The course consists of a EDM learning steps with CubeSat type classroom satellite kit. It is equipped with six primary subsystems – Electrical Power Supply, Command and Data Handling, Communication, Ground station, Sensor and Structure.You can learn how each component and subsystem functions and how to integrate components and subsystems into a satellite system through experiencing the process of assembly, integration including programing & system implementation and test.

description.zh: 本課程以簡要方式介紹我國專利法，內容主要涵蓋：專利申請、可專利標的、專利要件、專利審查流程、專利權之實施、專利侵害判斷、專利檢索及專利說明書之撰寫，尚包括專利訴訟流程、專利行政救濟流程以及專利法與其他智慧財產權法關係之簡介。
description.en: This course briefly introduces the patent law of our country, which covers the filing of the patent application, patentable subject matter, patentability, patent examination procedures, patent enforcement, patent infringement, patent search and patent specification drafting. Other subjects such as patent litigation proceedings, patent administrative remedy proceedings, and the introduction of the correlation of the patent law and other Intellectual Property laws are also included.

description.zh: 本課程提供學生們一個可以改善他們的科技英文寫作技巧的環境，內容將包括：1. 扼要複習英文句型與文法，2. 撰寫論文常發生的錯誤，3. 分享論文審稿的經驗，4. 提供淺顯實用的寫作原則，5. 同儕分享讀論文與寫作的錯誤心得。
description.en: This course provides an environment to help students improving their English skill in writing technical paper or thesis. What will be included in the class are: 1. concise review of sentence structure and grammar, 2. frequent writing mistakes of paper or report, 3. share of the experience in paper review, 4. offering simple and practical writing principles, 5. share the experience in reading and writing papers.

notes: 限111學年度(含)以前博士生修課,非博士班英文門檻補救

description.zh: 本所與美國新罕布夏大學富蘭克林皮爾斯法學院，已於112年5月10日簽署國際學術交流MOU，而本所為響應學校推動國際化之政策，特別增開1門1學分之國際雙師課程。本課程乃由美國新罕布夏大學富蘭克林皮爾斯法學院院長Megan Carpenter教授、該學院智慧財產權中心主任Micky Minhas教授親自來台密集授課，主要提供給欲深入了解美國法律制度、美國智慧財產權法律體系之本所學生、校外實務界人士或欲對赴美留學有興趣人士來選修。而本課程之內容，共分成兩個部分，前半部將以美國法律(包括法院、普通法、各部門法律等)之介紹為主，至於後半部則詳細介紹美國智慧財產權各部門法律(包含著作權法、專利法、營業秘密法、資料保護、商標法等)。而本課程之開課時間，以每學年度上學期之10月上旬，並為期1週為原則。當然，本課程開設之目的，乃以增強學生實際應用英語之能力，並以加強學生美國智慧財產權法律之知能為主，除了強化本所與美國新罕布夏大學富蘭克林皮爾斯法學院之學術交流關係外，更能夠擴展休課學生之國際人脈及視野。
description.en: Graduate Institute of Intellectual Property, National Taipei University of Technology (hereafter called this institute) had made a MOU of international academic cooperation with Franklin Pierce School of Law, University of New Hampshire on May 10, 2023. This institute wants to promote the international policy from the University, so this institute will open a one unit course for international double professional teachers. This course is personally and intensively taught by Professor/Dean Megan Carpenter and Professor/Director Micky Minhas of Franklin Pierce School of Law, University of New Hampshire, and it is mainly provided for this institute’s students, legal practitioners, or someone who are interested in studying in the U.S. for further understanding the U.S. legal and intellectual property law systems. Moreover, contents of this course are divided into two parts: the former part is introductions of the U.S. laws, including courts, common laws, and all aspects of laws, etc. But,

name.zh: 美國智慧財產權法律專題
name.en: Seminar on the U.S. Intellectual Property Law

notes: 國際雙師選修英文授課,預定113/11/04-11/09進行密集課

description.zh: 本課程為本校「智慧鐵道學程」的課程。課程開授之目標，是希望藉由實務傳承與實際場域參訪的方式，使修課學生能夠瞭解鐵道產業的內涵，並對國內鐵道產業的運作現況，有全面性的認識。本課程是以同時段合院授課的方式、針對選讀學程之學生、邀請鐵道事業單位（包括鐵道局、台鐵、北捷、桃捷、高鐵、鐵道建設規劃顧問公司等）、具十年以上相關工作經驗的專業人員、以業師的身份共同參與授課。本課程會安排實際場域（台鐵、北捷、桃捷）參訪交流行程，並會要求修課同學於期末報告時，針對國內鐵道產業現況提出具體建言。
description.en: This course is one of the courses for the Intelligent Rail Curriculum. The main purpose of this course is, via practical technology lecturing and on-site field visiting, to provide the students an overall understanding of the contents and the operational situation of domestic rail industry.This course is a joint lecture among departments inside our college with synchronized class hours. The industrial instructors to our participant students include senior professional practitioners with more than 10-year experiences from Ministry of Railway, Taiwan Railway Bureau (TRB), Taipei MRT, Taoyuan MRT, Taiwan High Speed Rail, and Consultant Agencies for Railway construction, etc. Field trips to operation sites such as TRB, Taipei MRT and Taoyuan MRT, will be scheduled. Each student will also need to submit a term paper regarding the review and suggestion for the domestic rail industry.

interdisciplinary: 智慧鐵道微學程

description.zh: 資訊都市主義（informatical urbanism或informational urbanism）為一跨領域學科，旨在透過資訊環境與流程之輔助，推動政策、規劃、發展、策略行動、設計之都市與社區進程。本課程主要在協助學生，以都市與社區問題為基本導向，建立資訊環境與流程之規劃能力。授課主要涵蓋面向：1.資訊與知識基礎設施 2.經濟面向 3.都市治理與公共行政 4.都市空間之資訊化 5.地點因子 6.使用者行為 7.特殊議題。
description.en: Informatical urbanism (or informational urbanism) is an interdisciplinary area of knowledge, and it mainly utilize the facilitation of informatical environments and procedures for the progression of policy, planning, development, strategic initiative, and design within cities and communities.During this course, student will acquire the planning capability of establish such applicable informatical environments and procedures, based upon explorations of urban and community issues.Main contents of this course: 1. Information and knowledge infrastructures, 2. Economic aspects, 3. Urban governance and administration, 4. Informaticalization of urban space, 5. Location factors, 6. User behavior, 7. Focus area of problem.

description.zh: 本課程使學生熟悉混凝土之材料組成、物理及力學性質，以及混凝土之配比及其近代發展。課程中亦包含混凝土之非線性分析，如潛變、乾縮及斷裂行為等。
description.en: This course provides students with material composition, physical and mechanical properties of concrete proportion and its modern development. Courses will also be included in the nonlinear analysis of concrete, creep, shrinkage and the failure theory and so on.

description.zh: 介紹各種潔淨且高效率的先進車輛動力系統的型式及其工作原理並分析技巧。項目包含車輛能源所面臨的一些問題及可能的解決方案、優良動力源的特性、電動系統、複合電動系統、複合氣動系統、氫燃料電池動力系統、金屬燃料電池動力系統、各種替代性燃料的特性及優缺點、太陽光電輔助動力系統等。
description.en: This course introduces various kinds of clean and high-efficiency vehicular power systems, their operation principles, and analytical skills. Topics include: problems and possible solutions the vehicular power system faces, characteristics of a good vehicular power system, electric power system, hybrid electric power system, hybrid pneumatic power system, fuel cell power system, metallic fuel-cell power system, substitutive fuels, and solar-energy auxiliary power system.

name.en: Special Topics on Clean Power System

interdisciplinary: 機電_第二專長【車輛系_車輛動力與能源】

description.zh: 自由度、(平面與空間)運動幾何分析、彈簧、避震器、力傳遞分析、撓性、電腦輔助懸吊系統分析與設計。
description.en: Degree of Freedom, (2D and 3D) Kinematic Analysis, Springs, Dampers, Force Analysis, Compliance, Computer Aided Analysis and Design of Suspension Systems.

description.zh: 聯合國教科文組織於1972年通過了《世界遺產公約》，旨在保護世界文化和自然遺產，並將保護和保存文化財產的概念連結起來。五十年來，世界遺產經歷多次變革，觀念與行動與時俱進，1992年，文化景觀概念正式確立，承認人與環境的相互作用和共生關係，縫合了長街以來自然和文化的割裂。2001年，全球文化多樣性宣言的通過，文化在不同時代和不同地方具有各種不同的表現形式，這種多樣性的具體表現，構成人類各群體和各社會具有的獨特性和多樣化。受此影響，文化景觀、無形遺產、水下遺產、產業遺產、文化路徑、聖山遺產、天文遺產紛紛出現。本課程屬建築保存應用課程，將介紹不同主題的世界遺產案例，其目的除了引領同學認識世界遺產觀念及思潮變遷外，亦對國內文化資產保存的學習有所啟發與反省。
description.en: UNESCO adopted the World Heritage Convention in 1972 to protect world cultural and natural heritage and link the concepts of protection and preservation of cultural property. Over the past fifty years, World Heritage has undergone many changes, and concepts and actions have kept pace with the times. In 1992, the concept of cultural landscape was formally established, recognizing the interaction and symbiotic relationship between people and the environment, and sewing up the separation between nature and culture since the Long Street. In 2001, the Global Declaration on Cultural Diversity was adopted. Culture has different forms of expression in different times and places. The specific manifestations of this diversity constitute the uniqueness and diversity of various human groups and societies. Affected by this, cultural landscapes, intangible heritage, underwater heritage, industrial heritage, cultural routes, sacred mountain heritage, and astronomical heritage have emerged one after a

description.zh: 了解國內外淨零碳排路徑策略、具備建築物生命週期的整體流程概念、具備建築碳足跡計算操作能力。課程講述建築生命週期碳足跡的評估法，藉由標準化、透明化的建築資訊剖析建築生命週期各階段對環境的影響，具備評估整棟建築生命週期的碳足跡，並提出減碳熱點，了解建築物的節碳潛力所在。
description.en: This course evaluates the carbon footprint of a building's lifecycle. Through standardized and transparent buildinginformation, the impact of various stages of the building lifecycle on the environment is analyzed step by step. Thiscourse not only evaluates the carbon footprint of the entirebuilding life cycle but also further identifies carbon hotspotsand provides carbon reduction strategies, hence understanding carbon savings potential of buildings.

description.zh: 本課程介紹自二十世紀開始重要建築事件與作品的演變。從現代主義、粗獷主義、後現代建築到各種回應時代性的的建築思潮的發展，每週選定一個主題說明之。
description.en: The course introduces critical architectural agendas, events, and projects after 1900, from modernism, brutalism, and postmodern architecture to the development of various architectural trends that respond to the times. Each week, the course will select one topic to explain and discuss.

description.zh: 本課程主要是介紹金屬、陶瓷、高分子材料之先進製造技術，以利修課學生能了解各種材料製程之原理、限制及其應用領域。另外，課程中也將介紹真空製程在材料製造所扮演的角色，並介紹基礎真空技術及理論。課程後半段將聚焦在材料的3D列印(積層製造)技術，包含美國材料試驗協會(ASTM)所分類的七大類3D列印技術，如粉體床熔化成型、黏結劑噴塗等製程技術。
description.en: This course mainly introduces advanced manufacturing technologies of metals, ceramics, and polymer materials, so that students can understand the principles, limitations and application fields of various material manufacturing processes. In addition, the course will also introduce the role of the vacuum process in material manufacturing and introduce basic vacuum technology and theory. The second half of the course will focus on 3D printing (additive manufacturing) technology of materials, including the seven major categories of 3D printing technologies classified by the American Society for Testing and Materials (ASTM), such as powder bed fusion, binder jetting, and other AM technologies.

name.en: Manufacturing and 3D Printing Techniques of Materials

description.zh: 本課程深入探討人工智慧領域的基礎知識和最新技術，包括機器學習、深度學習、自然語言處理、生成對抗網絡等領域。學員將從人工智慧的概述和歷史開始，逐步深入了解機器學習和深度學習的基礎概念和演算法，並探討其在不同領域的應用。課程還介紹了最新的AI技術趨勢，包括注意力機制、自監督學習、大型AI通用模型和元學習等。課程運作模式：每週講授一個主題，包括理論授課和實習操作。學員將參與課堂討論和小組活動，以促進想法交流和知識分享。
description.en: This course delves into the fundamentals and latest advancements in the field of artificial intelligence, covering topics such as machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, and generative adversarial networks. Participants will begin with an overview of artificial intelligence and its historical development, progressively delving into the foundational concepts and algorithms of machine learning and deep learning, along with their applications across various domains. The course also introduces the latest trends in AI technology, including attention mechanisms, self-supervised learning, large-scale AI models, and meta-learning.Course Execution: Each week covers a specific topic, including theoretical lectures and practical exercises. Participants will engage in classroom discussions and group activities to facilitate idea exchange and knowledge sharing.

name.zh: 人工智慧的基礎與創新(一)
name.en: Foundations and Advances in Artificial Intelligence I

description.zh: 此門課程的主要目標，將以介紹高等積體電路設計為主，讓學生了解高等積體電路設計的理論、概念、流程及方法。課程將理論與實際並重，讓學生具有實際的高等積體電路設計能力。
description.en: 1. Introduction2. Advanced VLSI System and Architecture Design3. Advanced VLSI Design Technique and Concept4. Still Image/Video Compression VLSI Design5. Digital Television VLSI Design6. Digital Camera VLSI Design7. Digital Watermarking VLSI Design

description.zh: 1.幾何光學2.波動光學3.光束光學4.傅氏光學5.光電磁學6.偏極光學與晶體光學
description.en: 1. Ray Optics2. Wave Optics3. Beam Optics4. Fourier Optics5. Electromagnetic Optics6. Polarization and Crystal Optics

description.zh: 認識英文學術論文的語法、文體、結構組織等特質，並探討英文報告及論文撰寫方式。
description.en: This course helps the learners recognize the syntax, style, and organization as far as the papers on English writings are concerned.

notes: 博班課程,碩士不計學分,2週【停開】

description.zh: 使學生瞭解國際金融之理論與國際金融市場之概況：1.國際金融市場形成之基礎和背景2.介紹中央銀行及國際公營金融中介機構3.外匯市場、國際債券市場、國際股票市場、衍生性金融商品市場4.國際利率套利與利率均衡論5.國際金融市場與金融創新
description.en: To understand theory of international finance and the international financial markets. 1.Introduction to the international financial markets 2.Central banks and international public financial intermediaries, such as BIS and World Bank. 3.Foreign Exchange Market, Int'l Bond Market, Int'l Stock Market, Derivative Market, etc. 4.Interest Rate Parity Theory. 5.Financial Revolution

description.zh: 為了鼓勵以及幫助學生用技術或者商業模式，聯合學校老師或是跨校同學，用商業的手段共同解決社會或者商業問題，本課程將以衝刺班的形式，邀請有創業經驗的老師、業師，透過工作坊的形式，幫助學生逐週的推進創業進度以及創業競賽演練，目標是幫助學生落實創業想法，應用在社會中並且帶來改變。
description.en: To encourage and help students using new technologies or new business models to solve problems in the society and the business world, this intense, pre-accelerator, 18-week course invites different professors and mentors with entrepreneurship experiences to help students develop their start-up ideas through workshops and startup competitions. The goal of this course is to help students realize their ideas and create actionable business solutions that can change the society.

interdisciplinary: 創業家精神微學程

description.zh: 隨著高齡化社會的來臨與國家對於身心障礙者生活福祉的重視，輔助科技相關資源與人才需求日益倍增，各類輔具產品使用已成為這些族群在醫療照護上與生活品質提升上不可或缺的一環。本門課程為「生醫輔助科技跨域微學程」之入門基礎課程，建立學生對輔助科技有基本的通盤認識，期許未來具備相關能力投入輔助創新產品研發。若未來有志投入輔助科技相關產業工作，建議微學程可由此門課程開始選修。由於輔助科技涵蓋醫學與工程相關領域專業知識技術的整合，故由本校與臺北醫學大學攜手合作，兩校多位教師一同共授，提供兩校各20位學生選修，以促進學生或教師間的交流合作，本課程上課地點除了在本校，將有部分週次於北醫校園上課。
description.en: With the advent of aging society and the country's emphasis on the well-being of people with physical and mental disabilities, the demand of assistive technology resources and manpower is getting increased. The use of various assistive products has become an indispensable part for these people in medical care and quality of life. Assistive technology covers and integrates expertise in medicine and engineering related fields. The aims of this course are to let students have the comprehensive understanding of the current status and future trends of assistive technology. This course is the basic course for the “Assistive Technology Interdisciplinary Program”. If students consider to involve assistive technology-related industries in the future, we encourage students to enroll this course.

interdisciplinary: 生醫輔助科技跨域微學程

description.zh: 課程將以體驗式教學訓練，提升學員表達技巧、舞台技巧、臨場反應。本課程主要目的在教授學生以設計思考思維與策略，運用主題式課程實戰小組簡報及個人簡報，快速釐清簡報製作及表達過程中重點，提升修課學員個人簡報製作能力及表達能力，幫助學生在未來創業及就業上以出色之個人簡報能力獲得面試者及投資者的青睞，領先於起跑點取得優勢。
description.en: The course will use experiential teaching training to improve students' expression skills, stage skills, and on-the-spot reactions. The main purpose of this course is to teach students establishing design thinking strategies. During the course practice group presentations and personal presentations training students to quickly clarify the key points in the process of presentation production and presentation, to improve the students' personal presentation production and presentation skills. Furthermore, assist students' entrepreneurship and employment in the future. Students who finished this course will be favored by interviewers and investors with his excellent personal presentation skills. And he will gain an advantage over the starting point.

name.zh: 企業最愛：高質感簡報溝通力
name.en: Corporate's Favorite: High-quality Communication and Presentation Ability

interdisciplinary: 創業家精神微學程

description.zh: 隨著科技的發展與產值快速成長，網路、電商、商業新模式等各式創業大行其道，成為許多創業者的新選擇，本課程邀請國內知名創業楷模或創業成功典範之企業經理人分享創業成功之經驗。以真實具體的創業經驗為教材，讓學生更深刻體驗創業家之精神。希冀以觀摩學習典範企業的具體經驗，帶領學生學習企業創新與創業的思維，進而激發學生追求成就的渴望，強化青年學子對人生願景的規劃。
description.en: Along with the prosperous development of Internet, the output value of E-commerce is growing fast. Launching a business on the internet has become a new choice for many entrepreneurs. We invite the domestic business manager, as the model of outstanding and successful enterprise, to share his experiences of achievement with students. By offering the real and specific examples, business manager will make students learn further about the enterprisers' entrepreneurship. Through their experiences, we hope students can learn innovations and creations of enterprise; furthermore, students can be inspired to pursue their ambition to strengthen their wills to plan the future.

name.zh: 創業講座—創業是一場馬拉松
name.en: Entrepreneurship Lectures- The persistance that makes the great entrepreneur

interdisciplinary: 創業家精神微學程
notes: 前六週密集授課、科技大樓國際會議廳

description.zh: 為了鼓勵以及幫助學生用技術或者商業模式，聯合學校老師或是跨校同學，用商業的手段共同解決社會或者商業問題，本課程將以衝刺班的形式，邀請有創業經驗的老師、業師，透過工作坊的形式，幫助學生逐週的推進創業進度以及創業競賽演練，目標是幫助學生落實創業想法，應用在社會中並且帶來改變。
description.en: To encourage and help students using new technologies or new business models to solve problems in the society and the business world, this intense, pre-accelerator, 18-week course invites different professors and mentors with entrepreneurship experiences to help students develop their start-up ideas through workshops and startup competitions. The goal of this course is to help students realize their ideas and create actionable business solutions that can change the society.

interdisciplinary: 創業家精神微學程

description.zh: 氣膠為懸浮在空氣中的微小固體或液體粒子。本課程深入探討氣膠科學（微塵學）及其工程上之應用。．氣膠理化特性，粒徑分布．氣膠運動學：擴散和布朗運動，過濾機制，荷電性質，熱泳等．光學特性及其應用．氣膠的測量原理與方法．大氣氣膠及生物氣膠
description.en: ．Indroduction:characterization of aerosols,shape and size distributions．Particle transport:Brownian motion and diffusion, centrifugation, intertia and filtration, convective diffusion,extermal forcr fields, thermal force．Optical properties:visibility, light scattering．Aerosol dynamics:coagulation, formation and growth．Atmospheric Aerosois and Bioaerosols．Measurement of aerosol

description.zh: 本課程旨在協助學生探究教育社會學的理論與實務，探討主題包含:社會化、社會階層、教育機會均等、技職教育與社會發展等，並期學生運用相關論點對當前技職教育問題提出建議。
description.en: This course is designed to assist students understanding the theory and practice of the sociology of education and applying sociological views to solve the problems. Topics include socialization and education, social change transition and education, equity of educational opportunity, collaboration between social development and technical-vocational education, etc.

description.zh: 校務研究（Institutional Research，以下簡稱IR）可說是針對校務所進行的各項研究，透過資料蒐集、分析、報告，以及教職員行動，以促進高等教育機構的運作與決定。同時IR的發展和大學評鑑的發展脈絡息息相關，最終的目的就是要提升學校辦學品質，促進學校良善發展。本課程主要希望加強同學對IR的了解及發展實作能力。
description.en: Institutional research is a broad category of work done at schools, colleges and universities to inform campus decision-making and planning in areas such as admissions, financial aid, curriculum, enrollment management, staffing, student life, finance, facilities, athletics, and alumni relations. Its mission is to foster a culture of evidence by facilitating the management, analysis, and reporting of institutional data and information in support of planning and decision-making. This curriculum is expected to provide all students understand the theory and practice of IR.

description.zh: 本課程希望讓學生了解如何正確選擇與使用多變項統計方法，並能閱讀、呈現與解釋多變項統計報告或結果。課程包括因子設計、實驗設計、共變數分析、複迴歸等主題，以探討教育研究中多重且同時的影響因素。
description.en: This curriculum lets students understand how to choose and use multi-variance statistics methods exactly. It also includes that reading, presenting and explaining the report or result of multi-variance statistics analysis exactly. The topics of the curriculum include that factor design, experimental design, covariance analysis, and multi-regression, al etc. to explore the influence of multi and simultaneous factors in the educational research.

description.zh: 為了使訓練資源的更有效運用，本課程希望讓學生了解，企業內部在實施訓練之前，應客觀、嚴謹的加以評估，並追蹤其實施後的成效，以正確評估訓練的效益。
description.en: To make better use of the training resources, the curriculum expects to make students understand that any enterprise should objectively and carefully evaluate the training program before its employment, and keep track of its effect after its employment to make sure the effectiveness of the training program.

name.zh: 教育訓練實施與績效評鑑

description.zh: 本課程簡述醫院常用的儀器其背後的物理原理及整合應用。讓學生為未來進入醫材領域預備足夠的背景知識，將本系所學生將所學之光電領域能力，進一步擴展至生醫光電的應用進行跨領域的學習。內容提及電腦斷層、磁振造影、超音波、核子醫學、內視鏡等原理。
description.en: This course briefly introduces the physical principles behind the instruments commonly used in hospitals and their integrated applications. To allow students to prepare enough background knowledge for entering the field of medical materials in the future, and to further extend the optoelectronic capabilities that students in this department have learned to the application of biomedical optoelectronics for cross-field learning. The content mentions the principles of computed tomography, magnetic resonance imaging, ultrasound, nuclear medicine, endoscopy, etc.

description.zh: 管理心理學係運用行為科學的方法，事實及歷程，以處理人們在工作中的行為及心理的一門科學。本課程希望讓學生了解管理心理學如何影響他們的生活與工作，並能有效地運用管理技巧來處理企業中的人與事。
description.en: Administrative psychology is a science, which makes use of the method, fact, and process of the behavior science to handle people's behavior and minds in their work. This curriculum is expected to make students understand how administrative psychology affect their life and work, and how to use the management skill to effectively deal with the personnel and matter in the enterprise.

description.zh: 課程的目標期待透過理論與案例研究幫助學生理解「金融科技」，包括改變付款方式的破壞力、分析不斷變化的監管環境，並對人工智慧、區塊鏈、上雲、行動銀行、開放銀行、機器人顧問、眾籌、P2P借貸等金融科技議題有著更深入的了解；此外，也介紹資訊安全與目前監管機構在金融科技的角色。
description.en: The objective of the course is to help students understand "Financial Technology" through theory and case studies, including the disruptive impact of changing payment methods, analyzing the constantly evolving regulatory environment, and gaining a deeper understanding of financial technology topics such as artificial intelligence, blockchain, cloud computing, mobile banking, open banking, robo-advisors, crowdfunding, peer-to-peer lending, etc. Additionally, it introduces information security and the role of current regulatory agencies in financial technology.

description.zh: 本課程偏重在如何將Python應用在金融實務領域上:怎麼取得網路上免費的資料，怎麼使用Python視覺化功能分析，怎麼使用Python進行有用的回測，怎麼做投資組合最佳化配置。
description.en: This course focuses on how to apply Python in the field of financial practice: how to acquire free data online, how to utilize Python's visualization capabilities for analysis, how to conduct useful backtesting using Python, and how to optimize investment portfolio allocation.

name.en: Application of Python in the financial field

description.zh: 本課程的重點在於闡述管理學之基本概念，主要的內容涵蓋四個領域：(1)瞭解管理學之理論與相關學者之研究報告；(2) 討論企業界管理應用實務案例；(3) 探討多國化管理之趨勢與差異及(4) 如何落實管理理論研討與趨勢。另外一有管理相關功能實務應用之討論與介紹
description.en: The purpose of Management has four distinct objectives:(1) to introduce a new management paradigm；(2) to effectively combine the basic concepts of management and organizational behavior into a single volume, including the management functional and departmental descriptions；(3) to discuss business management applications in practice and (4) to effectively implement the management basic ideas. The planning, organization, decision, leadership and monitoring among variety culture will be covered and discussed in the class as well.

description.zh: 本門課程是財務、電腦、與數學的結合，其主要目標為啟發學生如何設計電腦演算法來解決財務或經濟上的問題。一開始，此課程會複習一些基本的知識，如利率期間結構、選擇權評價理論、隨機過程模型、數值方法、與寫程式時所需的資料結構。之後，會講到一些新奇選擇權的演算法，包括亞洲式選擇權，障礙選擇權、回顧選擇權、重設選擇權、彩虹選擇權、可轉換公司債。
description.en: The major goal of this course is to provide students with complete understanding of many financial markets and products. Topics such as forward and futures, swaps, and options will be fully covered. In addition, the basic pricing methods of these innovative products will be emphasized in this course. Finally, even to a MBA student, the knowledge mentioned in this course is sure to be helpful for his (or her) future career.

notes: 資財四甲乙、資財所合開

description.zh: 本課程主要介紹資料探勘與大數據分析的理論方法與應用，課程內容涵蓋資料探勘的基本概念，如資料準備、資料探勘的方法與實證、資料探勘的進一步運用，並加入商業等各領域的實務案例介紹，具體說明如何應用資料探勘與大數據分析技術以解決真實問題。 另外在工具方面則透過相關分析軟體操作與實作範例輔以說明，讓學生學習資料的準備、工具的應用及分析判斷，透過實作課程，使學生能容易應用資料探勘方法，進而提升大數據分析和數位決策能力。
description.en: This course explores the rapidly developing fields of big data for the efficiency of decision making in various fields. The topics are about basic concepts of data manipulations, analytic, and communications which are including: introduction to big data; basic knowledge of data mining; special topics of big data in business Analytics, and data analytic project. The course will help students careful consideration of what is desired from big data, how big data analytic to add value to business, etc. Students can gain a strong data science knowledge set and techniques via in-depth case studies, most current readings and experiences, and most current and future technology exploration.

description.zh: 本課程將深入探討比特幣作為一種加密貨幣的獨特經濟特性。我們將從貨幣的基礎概念開始，接著介紹比特幣，探討其背後的區塊鏈技術以及去中心化的運作方式。然後，我們將探討比特幣的價值形成機制、供需動態、市場波動等相關議題，並探討其對傳統金融體系的影響，以及可能的未來發展趨勢。此外，再針對比特幣逐漸成為全球大南方新興市場國家的普惠金融方案之一的現象探討其原因與未來發展。
description.en: This course delves into the unique economic characteristics of Bitcoin as a cryptocurrency. We Start from the fundamental concepts of money, fiat currency, and then discuss the Bitcoin. We explore the underlying blockchain technology and decentralized operations. We then examine Bitcoin's value proposition, supply-demand dynamics, market volatility, and its impact on traditional financial systems, along with potential future trends. On top of that, Bitcoin is also gaining traction to become one of the financial inclusion solution in global south emerging countries, we also examine the reasoning and future development of this phenomena.

description.zh: 因應全球淨零碳排趨勢，能源管理與碳管理為國家各產業提升競爭力的重要環節。本課程將從ISO50001能源管理與ISO14064碳管理制度出發，講授能源管理、能源績效評估、碳管理、和績效提升/減碳計算之量測與驗證方法學。講授內容涵蓋：關鍵觀念、節能/減碳技術、績效/減碳量測與驗證方法、節能/減碳統計分析方法學、和案例EXCEL操作與討論。
description.en: In response to the global trend of net-zero carbon emissions, energy management and carbon management are important links in improving the competitiveness of various industries in the country. This course will start from the ISO50001 energy management and ISO14064 carbon management systems and teach the measurement and verification methodologies of energy management, energy performance assessment, carbon management, and performance improvement/carbon reduction calculations. The teaching contents cover: key concepts, energy saving/carbon reduction technology, performance/carbon reduction measurement and verification methods, energy saving/carbon reduction statistical analysis methodology, and EXCEL case practice and discussion.

name.zh: 能源績效量測驗證與碳管理
name.en: Energy Performance Measurement and Verification and Carbon Management

description.zh: 1. 衛星軌道與軌跡2. 數位通訊，多工技術3. 衛星通訊 - 衛星本體4. 衛星通訊 - 地面站5. 衛星鏈路分析與設計6. 衛星通訊應用
description.en: 1. Satellite Orbits and Trajectories2. Digital Communications, Multiple Access3. Communication Satellite - Space segment4. Communication Satellite - Earth segment5. Satellite Link Analysis and Design6. Applications of Satellite Communication

interdisciplinary: 低軌衛星系統應用微學程

description.zh: 本門授課之目的在於介紹奈米材料及其製程(包括化學法及物理法奈米材料法)，並探討奈米材料的未來發展及應用。所包括的課程主題如下：1.奈米材料與奈米化學簡介。2.奈米材料與結構分析3.量子力學; 4.奈米材料自我組成5. 奈米材料模擬6.碳化奈米材料7奈米材料製成 8.奈米材料的應用; 9.奈米材料的遠景與未來發展。
description.en: The course introduces nanomaterials and their preparation processes (including chemical method and physical methods). Future development and applications are also discussed. This course will cover the following topics:1. Introduction of nanomaterials and Nano-chemistry; 2. Nanomaterials: structure and analysis; 3. Quantum mechanics; 4. Nanomaterials: self-assembly; 5. Nanomaterials: simulation; 6. Carbon-based nanomaterials; 7. Synthesis and processing 8. Growth and application of semiconductor nanoparticles; 9. Prospective future of nanomaterials.

description.zh: 本課程旨在提升學生資訊領域的英語文能力，加強學生於該領域課堂學習與未來職業所需的閱讀與口說技巧。本課程中，學生將經由研讀資訊領域相關文章以及針對相關主題的討論，增加資訊領域的字彙，並加強英語能力與溝通技巧。
description.en: This course is designed for students who are interested in improving English skills in the field of information technology. It aims to increase students’ reading fluency and improve their speaking skills needed to function and succeed in classroom settings and in future career. In this course, authentic reading texts related to information technology will be used. Students will discuss topics, such as artificial intelligence and the World Wide Web, in order to expand vocabulary and language skills.

description.zh: 本課主要講授公司法的規定。相關的法律理論都會被介紹。學生將被指定閱讀教科書和法院判決。課堂參與是必要的。
description.en: This course teaches Company Act. Company Act covers procedural rules of incorporation, duties of a president, board members, or shareholders. Students will be assigned to read a textbook and several court decisions. Class participation is required.

interdisciplinary: 科技法律學程

description.zh: 著作權法係為保障著作人著作權益，調和社會公共利益，促進國家文化發展，所特別制定之法律。該法所稱著作包括：語文著作、音樂著作、戲劇、舞蹈著作、美術著作、攝影著作、圖形著作、視聽著作、錄音著作、建築著作、電腦程式著作等。著作權的保障內涵則包含因著作完成所生之著作人格權及著作財產權。本課程將兼顧實例與理論進行探討，來深化同學對於著作權的瞭解。
description.en: Copyright Act is specifically enacted for the purposes of protecting the rights and interests of authors with respect to their works, balancing different interests for the common good of society, and promoting the development of national culture. "Works" of this act, include the following:1.Oral and literary works.2.Musical works.3.Dramatic and choreographic works.4.Artistic works.5.Photographic works.6.Pictorial and graphical works.7.Audiovisual works.8.Sound recordings.9.Architectural works.10.Computer programs. "Copyright" means the moral rights and economic rights subsisting in a completed work.　The discussion in the course covers theory and examples, to enhance a deeper understanding of Copyright for the students.

interdisciplinary: 科技法律學程

description.zh: 本課程主要關注台灣發明、新型與設計專利申請的程序觀點。由於涵蓋範圍較廣，故分為專利申請實務(1)與專利申請實務(2)兩門課講授，本課程為先行之專利申請實務(1)。其相關的主題包括發明人身份、專利權人（專利申請權人）身份、優先權、申請格式、發明人訪談、專利標的、專利要件、專利分類與檢索、專利說明書及請求項之閱讀與撰寫等。此外，國際專利申請的實務觀點也會在課堂上討論以做為比較。本課程教材包括專利申請教科書、各國專利申請實務與審查基準、和法院判決等。
description.en: This course focuses on the procedural aspect of invention patent, utility model and design patent prosecution in Taiwan. As a wide range of different topics are designed to be covered, two courses named “Practice in Patent application (1)” and “Practice in Patent application (2)” are being offered and this is the first course (1). The topics cover inventorship, ownership (including a right to file a patent application), priority, formality, inventor interview, patentable subject matter, patentability, patent classification and search, patent specification and claim reading and writing, etc. In addition, the practical aspect of international patent prosecution is presented for comparison. The class materials include a patent prosecution textbook, patent prosecution and examination guidelines from different counties, and court decisions.

interdisciplinary: 科技法律學程

description.zh: 本課程旨在向修課同學作刑法之概括介紹，包括刑法總則及刑法分則。再者，此一介紹包含下列四個重點：一、刑法之背景及理論；二、刑法之解釋；三、刑法於案例事實之適用；四、刑法與刑事訴訟法之結合。參與本課程乃理解刑法之關鍵一步，修課同學將受益匪淺。
description.en: This course aims to give participants a general introduction to "Criminal Law", including "General Provisions" and "Specific Offenses". Furthermore, the introduction contains the following four points: 1. Background and theories of Criminal Law. 2. Interpretation of Criminal Law. 3. Application of Criminal Law to the facts. 4. Combination of Criminal Law and Criminal Procedure Law. Attending this course is the critical step to understanding Criminal Law, and it benefits participants a lot.

interdisciplinary: 科技法律學程

description.zh: 本課程講授英美契約法。其他資訊請參閱英文概述。
description.en: This course teaches basic rules of contract law applied in the United States. While contract law is a law of a state, this course does not focus on any specific jurisdiction. Students will be assigned to read a textbook and several court decisions. Class participation is required.

interdisciplinary: 科技法律學程

description.zh: 新經濟與舊經濟的分野不是在有『e』還是沒有『e』，而是在有『i』還是沒有『i』，而『i』就是『Innovation，創新』。二十一世紀的『腦力經濟』最重要的戲規則就是『智慧財產權』，同時也是WTO會員國必須遵守的重要規範之一。課程內容主要包括三個最基本的智慧財產權課題：專利權，商標權，以及著作權；而為配合本校學生學科背景，本課程將較著重於『專利』方面的實務知識，並且講授『如何激發創意，以培養學生日後能好好應用『智慧財產權』的保護。
description.en: The difference between New-economy and Old-economy is not caused by having "e" or not having "e", but caused by owining "i" or not owning "i". where "I" means "Innovation:. Intellectual Property is not only the most importance business rule of the :Brain economy era:, but also one of the most important agreements among WTO members. This course includes the basic three subjects of Intellectual Property:Patent, Trademark, and Copyright. In order to accommodate the learning background for most of NTUT students, the contents of this course will focus more on the practical practice of the Patennt. In addition, it also includes the subject of "how to activate your creativeness:so as to make students can use what they learn, "Intellectual Property:, to protect their intellectual work.

interdisciplinary: 科技法律學程

description.zh: 本課程將介紹我國民事法律制度，包括民法總則、債之關係、物權、親屬、繼承各篇，以主題解說搭配案例分析之模式進行，除培養學生具有基礎法律思維外，並加強學生問題解析之能力。
description.en: This course is to introduce the system of our country's Civil Law , including the gereral principles of the Civil Law , obligations , rights In Rem , family and succession. Running the course via topic explanations as well case analysis not only educates students to possess basic thoughts in law , but also enhances the ability in analyzing problems for students.

interdisciplinary: 科技法律學程

description.zh: 本課程將深入我國專利法，同時簡介美國及大陸專利法。本課程內容主要涵蓋：專利申請、可專利標的、專利要件及要求、專利審查流程、專利權之實施、專利侵害判斷、專利檢索及專利說明書之撰寫。其他內容尚包括簡介專利訴訟流程、專利行政救濟流程、法院及智慧財產局之角色以及專利法與其他智慧財產權法之關係。
description.en: This course will go through R.O.C. (Taiwan) patent law in detail, and introduce to the U.S. and China patent laws. Topics will mainly include patent filing, patentable subject matter, patent conditions and requirements, patent examination procedure, patent enforcement, patent infringement assessment, patent search, and patent drafting. Other topics include introduce to patent litigation procedure, patent administrative suit procedure, the roles of the court and the Intellectual Property Office and the relationship between patent law and other Intellectual Property laws.

interdisciplinary: 科技法律學程

description.zh: 民法總則介紹民法中的共通概念與基本原則，為整部民法以及所有法律的學習基礎。透過民法總則之學習，同學可以熟悉法律的思考模式及規範架構。本課程將以理論與實務並重方式協助同學學習。
description.en: The General Principle of the Civil Law serves to introduce the common concept and fundamental principle of the Civil Law. In short, the General Principle of the Civil Law predominates as a learning basis for the whole Civil Law and all legal study. Through learning on the General Principle of the Civil Law, students can be familiar with the model of legal thought and the framework of norm. This course aims to assist students learning from both theory and practice.

interdisciplinary: 科技法律學程

description.zh: 光電材料具備將光轉換為電能的能力，因此在當前的再生能源研究中中引起了廣泛與極大的關注。本課程著重介紹光電材料應用在光伏元件、發光二極體、光電感測器和薄膜電晶體。課程內容也包括半導體物理基礎知識、材料的分子結構、光吸收能力、載流子遷移率以及元件的穩定性和衰退的探討。
description.en: Optoelectronic materials have attracted much attention on a wide range of applications in renewable energy systems due to their ability to convert light into electricity. This course focus on introducing optoelectronic materials utilized in such kind of devices, photovoltaics, light-emitting diodes, photodetectors, and thin-film-transistors. This course also includes the fundamentals of semiconductor physics, materials’ molecular structures, light absorption capacity, carrier mobility and device’s stability and degradation.

name.zh: 光電材料於再生能源之應用
name.en: Optoelectronic Materials in Renewable Energy Applications

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 本課程將對公司治理做系統性的介紹。公司治理係指公司可以透過一系列的內部和外部公司治理機制設計來降低公司代理問題、提升公司價值。修課同學可以藉由閱讀指定參考文獻及教材並且在課堂上進行口頭報告，可以培養同學撰寫碩士論文及口頭報告的能力。
description.en: This course aims to present the concept of corporate governance. Corporate governance involves a series of mechanisms designed to mitigate agency problems within a corporation and enhance its value. We will cover both internal and external aspects of corporate governance. Students in the class are required to present a journal article and other assigned readings. All the training is intended to help students learn how to conduct their master thesis and improve their confidence in oral presentations.

description.zh: 本課程在使學生了解各種不同的資訊科技(Information Technology)與管理資訊系統間的關連性，並結合金融企業導入產業議題，實際應用所教授的IT技術進行學術研究。藉由IT技術的應用演練，讓學生將實際進行問題分析、模型發展、系統開發、模擬實驗及最後的研究結論與模型驗證。提升學生獨立思考與解決問題之能力，培養科學的態度與學術研究的知識。
description.en: This course is to enable students to understand the relationship between various Information Technology and management information systems, and cooperate with financial companies to introduce industrial topics, and actually apply the IT technology taught for academic research. Through the application and exercise of IT technology, students will actually carry out problem analysis, model development, system development, and simulation experiments. At last, students can summarize research conclusions and model validation. Thus, students can improve their independent thinking and problem-solving ability, and further cultivate their scientific attitude and academic research knowledge.

description.en: In this course, we will invite speakers from the academia, industry and government to lectures on topics in computer science and information engineering.

description.zh: 本課程主要是介紹六標準差方法。六標準差(Six Sigma)是一套管理系統，它是透過聆聽顧客的聲音(Voice of Customer)，經由關鍵品質(Critical to Quality)的分析，利用專案的方式，以流程改善工具解決有問題的企業流程。本課程著重了解“Six Sigma”理論、分析工具及統計應用軟體(Minitab)之運用，針對六標準差綠帶、黑帶專業培訓課程，藉由理論分析與實際操作使用的說明，協助學生將”Six Sigma”導入企業，以獲得關鍵流程的改進。
description.en: This course primarily introduces the Six Sigma methodology. Six Sigma is a management system that listens to the Voice of Customer, analyzes Critical to Quality factors, and utilizes project-based approaches with process improvement tools to address problematic business processes. The course focuses on understanding the theory of Six Sigma, analysis tools, and the application of statistical software (Minitab). It is designed for Green Belt and Black Belt professional training in Six Sigma. Through theoretical analysis and practical exercises, the course assists students in implementing Six Sigma in enterprises to achieve improvements in key processes.

description.zh: 以國外設計競賽(if & reddot)為主軸，輔導與協助學生積極的參與國外設計競賽，訓練學生獨立思考與問題解決能力。
description.en: This course aims to focus on domestic and international design competitions(if & reddot), guide and help students ' active, and let students have independent thinking and problem-solving skills.

description.zh: 音樂概論以透過此課程讓學生對音樂有總體認識，了解音樂的元素、技術理論及文化背景，同時在探索音樂美感構成上的標準，我們可以從探索不同歷史時期的人文思想背景，了解對於當時音樂創作理念與風格發展的影響，以及音樂審美觀念的發展演變之影響，立基於探索音樂的發展方向、藝術本質及審美意涵，對音樂藝術概念及美學思想之延伸探討。
description.en: Through this course—Introduction to Music, students would have a general understanding of music, understand the elements of music, technical theory and cultural background, at the same time in the music aesthetic to explore the composition of the standard, through exploring the different historical periods of humanistic background, to understand for the time that the idea of music composing and the impact of musical style development, as well as the development of music aesthetic concept of the evolution of the impact, based on discussing the development of music, the essence of art, and aesthetic meaning, to develop the concept of musical art, as well as a probe into the extension of aesthetic thought.

description.zh: 面對日益複雜的社會現象與社會組織，生活規範已由傳統的道德習俗，逐漸代之以法律倫理，生活在現代化的社會，有必要從認知法理、遵守法律，進而要求落實法治。俾政府施政依法而治，社會倫理得以重建，個人權益亦獲得確實的保障。本課程兼顧理論與實例的探討，包括法律的理念與概念、法律與社會生活各層面的關聯性、現行法體制的基本認識、法治生活的檢視與展望。
description.en: Facing increasingly complicated social phenomena and organization, norms of life are governed by laws instead of traditional moral customs. Living in modern society, it is necessary to have a better understanding of the law, so that people will abide by the law and further thoroughly implement the legal system to ensure that the government administration may be performed in accordance with the law. In this way, social ethic may be re-established and individual's benefit may be protected. The discussion in the course covers theory and examples, including the concept of the law, law and politic, law and society, law and life, etc.

interdisciplinary: 科技法律學程

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。

description.zh: 「生活美學」是現代人依據東西方文化及各方美學的定義所推論出來的名詞，指應用於「生活」中食、衣、住、行、育、樂所體現美的內容及活動。依循相異的生活型態、社會環境，人類試圖重構生活藝術化與藝術生活化的當代美學。
description.en: “Aesthetics of living " will address the East-West cultural and aesthetic experience through series of questions that drive the discourse in contemporary life’s content and activities. Following the different lifestyles, social environment, human tries to reconstruct everyday life into contemporary aesthetics of living. This course aims to encourage students to think what is aesthetic of living, through the real life and spiritual life and concerned itself with the aesthetic problems in the lives of others.

description.zh: 人類從尚未有文字的歷史以來，就有各種不同規模的戰爭，戰爭很吊詭的以你死或我亡，相互毀滅之態勢，爭奪「活著」的條件。古今中外，爆發戰爭的因素或為爭奪領土、權位、或為族群之戰、為意識形態之戰、或為物質資源之爭奪。在視覺影像發達的今日社會，有關戰爭的歷史影像的紀錄片與劇情片數量龐大、並有許多可觀之處。本課程將利用這些描寫戰爭影像資料，帶領同學瞭解相關戰爭與戰役爆發的歷史及其經過。
description.en: Throughout human history, even prior to written record, various types of warfare and scales of battles have existed for various purposes of domination or survival by all means of cruelty and destruction. The arousal of violent conflicts might be an attempt at fighting for territorial dominion or material resources economically or altering another species ideologically. In today's modern societies, bountiful documentaries and films concerning historical warfare have been accumulated. This course will aim at giving students a broad understanding and profound knowledge of the causes, process, and effects of significant warfare in human history with the aid of visual images in different media.

description.zh: 本課程目標如下：（一）以心理學為基礎，探討人類生活各面向的知識；（二）建立學生生活行為的技能；（三）促使學生建立自己積極的價值體系。 本課程內容涵蓋人類的個體發展、學習方式、動機、情緒、態度、人格、兩性、愛情、家庭、育兒、健康管理、社會行為等生活面的相關行為。 本課程採學生中心教學法，以啟發法、小組討論、創造式發表等方式授課，藉以活潑學生的思考並增加學生上台練習的機會。
description.en: The objectives of this course are : (1)By basing on the psychology to guide our students to discuss the variant facets of their lives. (2)To establish the students' good skills to deal with their own lives. (3)To found the students' positive value systems . This course includes the human behaviors of individual development , learning strategies, motivations, emotion, attitudes, personality, social interaction, religious lives, love, bisexual interaction, family lives, children cultivation , and etc. This course uses the learner-centered instructing strategies. The methods of discovery learning, teams discussion, creative teaching , and etc. will be adopted, in order to excite the students to do deep thought and give them the opportunities to show their efforts and achievements themselves.

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹中華民國憲法、探討憲政體制的運作、人民權利義務的規範及相關法律的適用等問題。期能使學生認知國家民主法治的實施狀況，維護社會秩序與個人基本權利，進而體現人性尊嚴的價值。
description.en: This course focuses the discussions on the Constitution of the Republic of China,constitutional mechanism, the rights and obligations for the people and legitimate operations of the society. It is our hope that the students may have a better understanding on how the democracy is performed in our country as well as on how to preserve social security and basic human rights of the individuals-with the realization of human dignity as our extreme goal.

description.zh: 經濟學重視邏輯與嚴謹推理的理性特質是其主要特色，此亦為理工科系人之專長優勢，然而僅偏重左腦訓練的人才往往讓人覺得生冷機械，對事物看法也常過於直接而缺乏人情，若能在不失理性效率之下，兼顧以人為本之社會人文感性關懷，則經濟學自無愧為社會科學之母，其訓練目標亦與通識教育的人格均衡發展目的一致！為避免陷入一般經濟教學因理論工具比重過高而失焦，導致學生學習興趣驟減以致成效不彰，本課程重點在於先讓學生擁有強烈之學習動機，接著認知到"確立學習目的"的重要性，藉由生活實例直接帶領學生面對並感受問題，從而引導出經濟學切入問題的思維方式，並傳授其正確可行的學習態度與方法，同時提醒學生維持對專業知識批判的精神，在嚴謹訓練架構下督促其尋求感性的意涵，因而不致陷入經濟工具與名詞的浩瀚泥沼中，從而漸進體會出經濟學之精髓。
description.en: The science of economics is characterized by logics and cautious reasoning-at which most of the students of natural science and technology are good at. It is also a fact that those who take better advantage of the right brain are very likely to be straightforward and thus seemingly more mechanical and unsympathetic. Economics can be seen as the mother of science under the condition that rational efficiency-as well as the socially humanity--are kept at the same time. As a matter of act, the economic trainings share the same goal as what is required by the General Education courses.The first priority of the course is to highly motivate the students in the economic issues. We do our best to avoid too much weight generally put into teaching economics, leading to poor learning and teaching experience. Cases are studied in such a way that students will recognize the "real purpose of studying." Real cases and examples are brought into discussion. We guide the students to"feel"the problems.

description.zh: 生命科學概論，重心放在人體生命科學，並強化醫學的角色。此外，中西醫結合的觀點，詮釋抗老、防癌。以身心靈養生的方式，強化預防醫學。並從人類疾病的本源性病因，根本探討。當然，如何增強免疫力，袪除自由基是主軸。在探究人體潛能、身心靈養生或疾病的本源性原因時，都必須重視「經絡」系統。總之生命是非常奧妙的，不僅只物質面，更要重視心靈層面，中西醫整合方向，必是廿一世紀的主流。
description.en: This course focuses on human life science and emphasizes the roles of medicine on improving the life quality of human beings. It also uses the point of view of integration traditional Chinese and western medicine to interpret how to prevent the aging of body and occurrence of cancers. This course also focuses on how to keep the body, mind and spirit in the best conditon in order to prevent the occurrence of human diseases. In addition, it deeply discusses the eseential etiology of human disease and teaches audiences how to enhance the body immunity and how to get rid of free radicals. The importance of meridian system of the human body and its relationships to human potentiality, body, mind spirit and diseses are also discussed. Life is marvelous. The completeness of life depends on the saisfaction of not only the material but also menetal and spiritual needs. Integration of the traditional Chinese and western medicine to improve the life quality of human beings is the main issue.

interdisciplinary: 生醫材料學程

description.zh: 透過分析創新成功之實際個案，讓修課同學了解創新的本質。課程中將介紹不同類型的創新個案，包括：技術創新、產品創新、服務創新與管理創新。本課程也擬搭配邀請成功之創業顧問與談，提供實務經驗，分享創業者該有的認知以及創業的重要理念，當然也包括分享他們在邀創業過程中所面臨的各類挑戰。創業是每個人都曾經懷抱過的夢想，透過創新成功之個案的分析，可以了解到個案公司是如何有步驟的循序漸進。針對每個個案，我們要求每位同學於課前完成個案的閱讀，並於上課前交出本次課程的課前預習心得。我們希望每位參與的同學都能在討論時充分表達意見，遇有不清楚或不同意見時能夠勇於提出他們的看法。本課程擬營造出一種研究的環境，讓學生可以針對個案盡其所能清楚的提出建議並來說服同儕。
description.en: The course enable participant to realize the essential features of innovation via cases study. Various types of innovation cases are included, such as: technology innovation, service innovation and management innovation. We also plan to invites some successful constants to give participants talk and share their experiences, including the challenge and their resolving process.The real case study enables participants to understand the entrepreneurship and the steps to start a business. The participants are required to complete the case reading and a preview report is required in advance the class. We hope that every participant can propose their opinion and persuade others colleges of their viewpoints.

interdisciplinary: 產品創新開發與評估微學程

description.zh: 學習相似於Microsoft Power Point 的「拖-拉-點-選」操作方式，再加上一小部份的 Low Code程式編碼，即可以設計與製作出:「專業級的 APP」 !本課程運用學校內的雲端平台: AgilePoint NX，改變了以往撰寫APP 的模式，不再需要撰寫複雜的程式碼，讓學生專注於 APP的邏輯流程與UI(使用者介面)，進而發展貼近市場裡的商業模式，設計出精彩的APP!課程的教學，採用傳統臺北工專的黑手工程師訓練模式:「由經入史」:先講解理論架構，進而延伸到產業的實務運用。嚴格要求上課同學動手實做，達成每週的設定目標。課堂上講師所示範的範例非常豐富，下課後會有一定份量的Homework(實作型作業)。經此系統化訓練，在APP的設計與製作上，將擁有踏實的內涵與技術，增強在校學生，未來在職場上的競爭力。「讓不懂IT(資訊工程)、非理工背景的學生，更能設計出高人氣的APP! 」
description.en: Learn the "Click and Drag" operation method, as like Microsoft Power Point, and adds some Low-Code, you can design and create: "Professional APP"!This course uses the cloud platform in the school: AgilePoint NX, which changes the mode of writing APP in the past, no longer needs to write complex code, let students focus on the logic flow of the APP and UI (user interface), and then close to the market requirement. This course uses the Taipei Tech Practical-Engineer training method:"From Theory to Practical": First explain the theoretical structure, and then extend to the practical application of the industry. Through this systematic training, in the design and production of APP, we will have practical connotation and technology to enhance the competitiveness of students in college and the future in the workplace."Let students who don't understand IT (information engineering) and non-technical backgrounds can design great and popular APPs!"

name.en: Start to APP Design and Application
